confidencePolicy.INFERRED: Hipótese lógica; apenas explicativa até validação.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Três zonas diferentes; mobilidade e interrupção reduzem drasticamente dano e knockups.
mechanics.officialSummary: Aatrox slams his greatsword down, dealing physical damage. He can swing three times, each with a different area of effect.

mechanics.label: Bloqueio de trajetória
mechanics.note: O alvo precisa abandonar a zona ou será puxado de volta; forte após setup, fraco contra mobilidade livre.
mechanics.officialSummary: Aatrox smashes the ground, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. Champions and large monsters have to leave the impact area quickly or they will be dragged to the center and take the damage again.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Abates prolongam a janela de velocidade, dano e cura, mudando lutas em sequência.
mechanics.officialSummary: Aatrox unleashes his demonic form, fearing nearby enemy minions and gaining attack damage, increased healing, and Move Speed. If he gets a takedown, this effect is extended.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Charm interrompe movimentos e é a condição central do pick; projéteis, minions e spell shields reduzem a entrega.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and charms an enemy it encounters, instantly stopping movement abilities and causing them to walk harmlessly towards her.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Múltiplos dashes com recargas adicionais após takedown permitem novo acesso ou saída.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, damaging nearby enemies. Spirit Rush can be cast up to three times before going on cooldown, and gains additional recasts when taking down enemy champions.

mechanics.label: Invisibilidade
mechanics.note: Shroud nega seleção e cria janela de espera; revelação verdadeira e dano em área preservam resposta.
mechanics.officialSummary: Akali drops a cover of smoke and briefly gains Move Speed. While inside the shroud, Akali becomes invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: O recast acompanha deslocamentos extremos do alvo, mas pode levar Akali para uma posição suicida.
mechanics.officialSummary: Flip backward and fire a shuriken forward, dealing magic damage. The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target, dealing additional damage.

mechanics.label: Execução
mechanics.note: Segundo dash escala com vida perdida e atravessa a luta; controle confiável pune a trajetória.
mechanics.officialSummary: Akali leaps in a direction, damaging enemies she strikes. Re-cast: Akali dashes in a direction, executing all enemies she strikes.

mechanics.label: Revive de aliados
mechanics.note: Matar o Scoundrel revive aliados abatidos por ele; valor cresce em lutas com trocas de abates.
mechanics.officialSummary: Akshan passively marks enemy champions as Scoundrels when they kill his ally champions. If Akshan kills a Scoundrel, he resurrects the allies they killed, gains bonus gold, and clears all marks.When activated, Akshan enters camouflage and gains Move Speed and Mana Regen while moving towards Scoundrels. Akshan loses the camouflage quickly while he is not in brush or near terrain.

mechanics.label: Travessia de terreno
mechanics.note: Swing depende de terreno e é encerrado por colisão; zonas fechadas podem ampliar ou destruir a rota.
mechanics.officialSummary: Akshan fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it, repeatedly firing at the nearest enemy while swinging. He can jump off early or gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain.

mechanics.label: Amplificação contra alvo isolado ou marcado
mechanics.note: Execução canalizada pode ser bloqueada por campeão, minion ou estrutura; formação importa mais que alcance nominal.
mechanics.officialSummary: Akshan locks onto an enemy champion and starts storing bullets. When released, he fires all stored bullets, dealing damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Headbutt é point-and-click, mas exige alcance curto e pode salvar o alvo se a direção for ruim.
mechanics.officialSummary: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Knockup em área converte W, Flash ou engage aliado e interrompe canais.
mechanics.officialSummary: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air.

mechanics.label: Limpeza de controle
mechanics.note: Remove CC e abre uma janela de redução extrema de dano para absorver foco e torre.
mechanics.officialSummary: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.

mechanics.label: Redução extrema de dano
mechanics.note: Permite comprometer a posição sem explodir; dano verdadeiro e luta prolongada continuam válidos.
mechanics.officialSummary: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Cada habilidade pode virar um dash curto; grounding e anti-dash afetam praticamente todo o padrão de troca.
mechanics.officialSummary: Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.

mechanics.label: Supressão
mechanics.note: Blink em linha alcança o campeão mais distante atingido e suprime; depende de alinhamento, não de atravessar a frontline.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Duas Bandage Toss oferecem engage repetido, mas continuam sendo projéteis bloqueáveis.
mechanics.officialSummary: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.

mechanics.label: Dano percentual de vida
mechanics.note: Dano contínuo de vida máxima pune frontlines quando Amumu consegue permanecer próximo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum Health each second and have their Curses refreshed.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Stun em área ao redor do corpo; excelente follow-up, condicionado ao acesso.
mechanics.officialSummary: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his Curse, damaging and stunning them.

mechanics.label: Revive próprio
mechanics.note: Ovo exige um segundo abate localizado e pode ser protegido por aliados, parede e ultimate.
mechanics.officialSummary: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.

mechanics.label: Criação de terreno
mechanics.note: Parede impassável corta cargas, separa formações e multiplica valor contra composições curtas.
mechanics.officialSummary: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Zona contínua de dano e slow domina corredores, mas pode ser interrompida ao controlar Anivia.
mechanics.officialSummary: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Stun preparado transforma Q em controle point-and-click ou W/R em controle de área; o estado da passiva é visível.
mechanics.officialSummary: After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: Tibbers cria unidade persistente, bloqueia skillshots e mantém pressão após o burst.
mechanics.officialSummary: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Cinco armas e ordem de munição mudam alcance, sustain, área, controle e DPS; a janela atual deve ser conhecida.
mechanics.officialSummary: Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Basic Attack and Ability. Attacks and abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next of the 5.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Gravitum converte slows aplicados em root à distância, mas só existe quando a arma está disponível.
mechanics.officialSummary: Aphelios has 5 different activated abilities, based on his main-hand weapon:Calibrum (Rifle): Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack.Severum (Scythe Pistol): Run fast while attacking nearby enemies with both weapons.Gravitum (Cannon): Root all enemies slowed by this weapon.Infernum (Flamethrower): Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your off-hand weapon.Crescendum (Chakram): Deploy a sentry that shoots your off-hand weapon.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: A sentry de Crescendum cria objeto de zona e aplicação da arma secundária.
mechanics.officialSummary: Aphelios has 5 different activated abilities, based on his main-hand weapon:Calibrum (Rifle): Long range shot that marks its target for a long-range follow-up attack.Severum (Scythe Pistol): Run fast while attacking nearby enemies with both weapons.Gravitum (Cannon): Root all enemies slowed by this weapon.Infernum (Flamethrower): Blast enemies in a cone and attack them with your off-hand weapon.Crescendum (Chakram): Deploy a sentry that shoots your off-hand weapon.

mechanics.label: Ataques com regra própria
mechanics.note: Autos aplicam slow permanente; reduz valor de campeões sem gap close repetido e sofre contra imunidade/cleanse.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ashe's attacks slow their target, causing her to deal increased damage to these targets.Ashe's critical strikes deal no bonus damage but apply an empowered slow to the target.

mechanics.label: Visão global
mechanics.note: Hawkshot verifica rota, objetivo e flanco no mapa inteiro sem exigir combate.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ashe sends her Hawk Spirit on a scouting mission anywhere on the map.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Stun global cresce com distância; alto impacto, mas projétil lento permite dodge e negação.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ashe fires a missile of ice in a straight line. If the arrow collides with an enemy Champion, it deals damage and stuns the Champion, stunning for longer the farther arrow has traveled. In addition, surrounding enemy units take damage and are slowed.

mechanics.label: Escalonamento infinito
mechanics.note: Stardust aumenta área, execução e alcance de múltiplas habilidades; tempo de jogo muda a identidade do kit.
mechanics.officialSummary: Aurelion Sol's damaging Abilities break down enemies into stacks of Stardust, which permanently improves each of his abilities.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Dano sustentado exige manter linha no mesmo alvo e pode ser interrompido ou quebrado por range.
mechanics.officialSummary: Aurelion Sol channels his dragon breath for a few seconds, damaging the first enemy hit and splashing reduced damage onto nearby enemies. Each second the breath is channeled directly at an enemy will deal bonus damage, which is improved by the amount of Stardust that's been collected. This ability collects Stardust if the target is a champion.

mechanics.label: Execução
mechanics.note: Black hole puxa e executa por limiar, ficando mais largo com stacks.
mechanics.officialSummary: Aurelion Sol summons a black hole, damaging enemies and slowly pulling them toward its center. This ability grants Stardust each time an enemy dies within the black hole and for each second an enemy champion is caught inside it. The center of the black hole executes enemies who are below a certain percentage of their maximum health. Stardust increases Singularity's area as well as the execution threshold.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Versão evoluída cria knockup enorme e onda global; depende de Stardust acumulado.
mechanics.officialSummary: Falling Star: Aurelion Sol crashes a star into the earth. This impact deals magic damage and stuns enemies while also granting Stardust for each enemy champion it hits. Gathering enough Stardust transforms Aurelion Sol's next Falling Star into The Skies Descend.The Skies Descend: Aurelion Sol drags a giant star down from the heavens with an increased impact zone and increased damage, knocking up enemies rather than stunning them. A shockwave then spreads from the edge of the impact zone, which damages and slows the enemies it hits. Stardust increases the impact area of both Falling Star and The Skies Descend.

mechanics.label: Invisibilidade
mechanics.note: Salto seguido de invisibilidade oferece reposicionamento, mas área e revelação ainda conectam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed for a short duration of time.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Cria área que desacelera inimigos e permite teleporte entre bordas, redefinindo espaço de luta.
mechanics.officialSummary: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: Soldados substituem autos e definem alcance/DPS; deslocar ou sair da zona remove aplicação.
mechanics.officialSummary: Azir summons a Sand Soldier to attack nearby targets for him, replacing his basic attack against targets within the soldier's range. Their attacks deal magic damage to enemies in a line.

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Dash exige soldado existente; destruir a formação ou negar posição muda escape e engage.
mechanics.officialSummary: Azir shields himself briefly and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, damaging enemies. If he hits an enemy champion, he instantly readies a new Sand Soldier for deployment and halts his dash.

mechanics.label: Criação de terreno
mechanics.note: Parede móvel desloca e depois bloqueia passagem, separando engage e backline.
mechanics.officialSummary: Azir summons a wall of soldiers which charge forward, knocking back and damaging enemies.

mechanics.label: Portal de terreno
mechanics.note: Túnel atravessa terreno para ambos os times; oferece rota única de engage/escape que pode ser armadilha.
mechanics.officialSummary: Bard opens a portal in nearby terrain. Allies and enemies alike can take a one-way trip through that terrain by moving into the portal.

mechanics.label: Stasis
mechanics.note: Coloca campeões, monstros, minions e torres em stasis; pode iniciar, salvar, negar objetivo ou arruinar a própria luta.
mechanics.officialSummary: Bard sends spirit energy arcing to a location, putting all champions, minions, monsters, and turrets hit into stasis for a brief time.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Quatro direções têm cooldown separado; paredes e grounding restringem rotas disponíveis.
mechanics.officialSummary: Bel'Veth dashes in a chosen direction and damages all enemies she passes through.

mechanics.label: Redução extrema de dano
mechanics.note: Canal enraizado reduz dano e executa o alvo de menor vida; hard CC interrompe a janela.
mechanics.officialSummary: Bel'Veth roots herself in place, channeling a storm of slashes around her that targets the lowest-health enemy and grants her lifesteal and damage reduction.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: Coral de monstro épico habilita enxame de Remora e pressão estrutural excepcional.
mechanics.officialSummary: Bel'Veth consumes Void coral remnants, transforming into her true form and increasing her max health, attack range, and attack speed. Consuming the Void coral remnants of a Void epic monster will grant her the power to summon Void remora.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Hook reposiciona completamente o primeiro alvo atingido; minions, summons e negação de projétil são counters centrais.
mechanics.officialSummary: Blitzcrank fires their right hand to grab an opponent on its path, dealing damage and dragging it back to them.

mechanics.label: Quebra de escudo
mechanics.note: Remove escudos próximos antes do dano e silêncio, mudando matchups contra enchanters e shield stacks.
mechanics.officialSummary: Enemies attacked by Blitzcrank are marked and take lightning damage after 1 second. Additionally, Blitzcrank can activate this ability to remove nearby enemies' shields, damage them, and silence them briefly.

mechanics.label: Silêncio
mechanics.note: Silêncio em área interrompe canais e impede resposta imediata após o hook.
mechanics.officialSummary: Enemies attacked by Blitzcrank are marked and take lightning damage after 1 second. Additionally, Blitzcrank can activate this ability to remove nearby enemies' shields, damage them, and silence them briefly.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Três aplicações detonam em área e espalham pressão; composições agrupadas aumentam muito o dano.
mechanics.officialSummary: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Stun só existe no alvo já em chamas, tornando aplicação anterior e bloqueio do projétil decisivos.
mechanics.officialSummary: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Após a primeira aplicação, autos aliados acumulam o stun; composições de ataque rápido convertem melhor.
mechanics.officialSummary: Braum's basic attacks apply Concussive Blows. Once the first stack is applied, ally basic attacks also stack Concussive Blows. Upon reaching 4 stacks, the target is stunned and takes magic damage. For the next few seconds they cannot receive new stacks, but take bonus magic damage from Braum's attacks.

mechanics.label: Negação de projéteis
mechanics.note: Intercepta todos os projéteis na direção e anula o primeiro dano; posicionamento lateral contorna.
mechanics.officialSummary: Braum raises his shield in a direction for several seconds, intercepting all projectiles causing them to hit him and be destroyed. He negates the damage of the first attack completely and reduces the damage of all subsequent attacks from this direction.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Frenzy entrega controle parcial ao jogo e persegue o alvo; pode ser explorada com isca, invisibilidade e reposicionamento.
mechanics.officialSummary: Briar leaps forward and shatters her pillory, entering a Blood Frenzy that causes her to relentlessly pursue the nearest enemy (prioritizing champions). While frenzied, she gains increased Attack Speed and Move Speed, and her attacks deal damage in an area around her target.Briar can reactivate this ability while frenzied to take a CHOMP out of her target on her next attack, dealing additional damage based on their missing Health, and healing Briar based on the damage she deals.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Projétil semiglobal leva Briar ao alvo e inicia Frenzy; acertar o alvo errado pode perder a luta.
mechanics.officialSummary: Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone, marking the first champion it hits as her prey. She then beelines straight to them, fearing other surrounding enemies upon arriving at her target, and enters a state of complete hemomania. She will pursue her prey until death, gaining the benefits of Blood Frenzy as well as additional Armor, Magic Resistance, Life Steal, and Move Speed.

mechanics.label: Armadilhas e preparação de terreno
mechanics.note: Armadilhas controlam corredores e convertem CC aliado em headshot; exigem preparação ou setup.
mechanics.officialSummary: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Recuo próprio cria distância e atravessa paredes finas, mas é um projétil e tem trajetória previsível.
mechanics.officialSummary: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.

mechanics.label: Amplificação contra alvo isolado ou marcado
mechanics.note: Execução de longo alcance pode ser bloqueada por outro campeão, premiando formação e frontline.
mechanics.officialSummary: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.

mechanics.label: Travessia de terreno
mechanics.note: Hookshot exige terreno para estender engage e stun; zonas abertas reduzem alcance prático.
mechanics.officialSummary: Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.

mechanics.label: Isolamento de alvo
mechanics.note: Ult point-and-click prende um alvo e expulsa os demais, anulando escapes mas não dano externo posterior.
mechanics.officialSummary: Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area. She also deals bonus magic damage to the target with her basic attacks.

mechanics.label: Dano verdadeiro estrutural
mechanics.note: Segundo Q converte dano em verdadeiro após espera; kite e negar recast reduzem o anti-tank.
mechanics.officialSummary: Camille's next attack deals bonus damage and grants bonus Move Speed. This spell can be recast for a short period of time, doing significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays a period of time between the two attacks.

mechanics.label: Grounding
mechanics.note: Miasma bloqueia habilidades de movimento dentro da área; enorme contra dashes, irrelevante se o alvo luta fora dela.
mechanics.officialSummary: Cassiopeia releases several clouds of poison, slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies that pass through them. Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Stun depende de o inimigo estar olhando para Cassiopeia; de costas recebe apenas slow.
mechanics.officialSummary: Cassiopeia releases a swirl of magical energy from her eyes, stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.

mechanics.label: Silêncio
mechanics.note: Silêncio em cone impede combo e canais antes do knockup ou execute.
mechanics.officialSummary: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.

mechanics.label: Execução ou segurança de objetivo
mechanics.note: Dano verdadeiro de alto valor garante monstros e acumula vida; acesso corpo a corpo continua obrigatório.
mechanics.officialSummary: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum Health.

mechanics.label: Dano verdadeiro estrutural
mechanics.note: Execute point-and-click ignora resistências e pune alvos sem ferramenta de negar o limiar.
mechanics.officialSummary: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum Health.

mechanics.label: Ataques com regra própria
mechanics.note: Parte dos autos vira dano verdadeiro, reduzindo eficiência de resistências tradicionais.
mechanics.officialSummary: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is dealt as bonus true damage.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Cone contínuo reduz Armor e MR, valorizando aliados que batem no mesmo alvo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy Armor and Magic Resist.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Mísseis acumulam e cada terceiro é ampliado; engage durante baixa munição reduz poke.
mechanics.officialSummary: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, up to a maximum. Every 3rd missile fired will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Lâmina externa cura e causa dano maior; entrar no cabo ou deslocar durante o cast quebra trocas.
mechanics.officialSummary: Darius winds up and swings his axe in a wide circle. Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle. Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Execução em dano verdadeiro reseta após abate e espalha Noxian Might, permitindo limpar a luta.
mechanics.officialSummary: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target. If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.

mechanics.label: Dano verdadeiro estrutural
mechanics.note: Ignora resistências, mas exige stacks e contato; kite continua sendo o counter principal.
mechanics.officialSummary: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target. If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Dash point-and-click reseta em alvo marcado pelo Q, deixando o segundo acesso dependente do acerto inicial.
mechanics.officialSummary: Becomes the living embodiment of the vengeful moon, dashing to an enemy and dealing magic damage.Lunar Rush has no cooldown when used to dash to an enemy afflicted with Moonlight. All other enemies will have the Moonlight debuff removed regardless of whether they were the target of Lunar Rush.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Puxa inimigos próximos e escala com múltiplos alvos; enorme com follow-up, exige entrada corporal.
mechanics.officialSummary: Diana reveals and draws in all nearby enemies and slows them.If Diana pulls in one or more enemy champions, the moonlight crashes down onto her after a short delay, dealing magic damage in an area around her, increased for each target beyond the first pulled.

mechanics.label: Escudo de habilidade
mechanics.note: Resiste ao primeiro efeito imobilizante e pode recuperar a lata; poke ou CC descartável remove a proteção.
mechanics.officialSummary: Dr. Mundo resists the first Immobilizing effect that hits him, instead losing Health and dropping a chemical cannister nearby. Dr. Mundo can pick it up by walking over it, restoring Health and reducing this Ability's Cooldown.Dr. Mundo also has significantly increased Health regeneration.

mechanics.label: Redução extrema de dano
mechanics.note: Regeneração massiva funciona como janela anti-burst prolongada; anti-heal e dano sustentado continuam centrais.
mechanics.officialSummary: Dr. Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, instantly healing a percent of his missing Health. He then gains Move Speed and regenerates a portion of his maximum Health over a long duration.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Catching axes revela trajetórias e mantém dano; zoneamento do ponto de queda derruba seu DPS.
mechanics.officialSummary: Draven's next attack will deal bonus physical damage. This axe will ricochet off the target high up into the air. If Draven catches it, he automatically readies another Spinning Axe. Draven can have two Spinning Axes at once.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Cash-in converte uma kill em pico econômico, enquanto morrer remove stacks e muda a lane.
mechanics.officialSummary: Draven gains his fans' Adoration when he catches a Spinning Axe or kills a minion, monster, or tower. Killing enemy champions grants Draven bonus gold based on how much Adoration he has.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Stun e shield exigem prever onde Ekko entrará segundos depois; setup aliado aumenta confiabilidade.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ekko's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage to low health enemies. He can cast Parallel Convergence to split the timeline, creating an anomaly after a few seconds that slows enemies caught inside. If Ekko enters the anomaly, he gains shielding and stuns enemies by suspending them in time.

mechanics.label: Intargetabilidade
mechanics.note: Fica inalvejável e retorna à posição do clone, curando e causando dano; rastrear o clone limita a fuga.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ekko shatters his timeline, becoming untargetable and rewinding to a more favorable point in time. He returns to whenever he was a few seconds ago, and heals for a percentage of the damage received in that duration. Enemies near his arrival zone take massive damage.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Cocoon é a condição de pick e pode ser bloqueado por minions, summons e negação de projétil.
mechanics.officialSummary: Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed.Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. After descending on an enemy target, Elise's bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen is increased.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Forma humana oferece range/setup; aranha oferece execute, sustain e acesso, mudando resistências e padrão.
mechanics.officialSummary: Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.

mechanics.label: Intargetabilidade
mechanics.note: Rappel remove Elise do mapa brevemente e permite descer em alvo; sem unidade próxima perde reposicionamento.
mechanics.officialSummary: Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed.Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. After descending on an enemy target, Elise's bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen is increased.

mechanics.label: Camuflagem
mechanics.note: Camuflagem permanente após nível 6 muda visão e posicionamento; control wards e proximidade revelam.
mechanics.officialSummary: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Demon Shade. Demon Shade heals Evelynn when she is low on health and grants Camouflage after level 6.

mechanics.label: Amplificação contra alvo isolado ou marcado
mechanics.note: Charm carregado revela a direção de Evelynn e reduz resistências; ativação precoce troca controle por surpresa.
mechanics.officialSummary: Evelynn curses her target, causing her next attack or spell after a delay to charm her target and reduce their magic resist.

mechanics.label: Intargetabilidade
mechanics.note: Execute em área torna Evelynn inalvejável e a reposiciona para trás, negando resposta imediata.
mechanics.officialSummary: Evelynn briefly goes untargetable and decimates the area in front of her before warping backwards a long distance.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: DPS e redução de cooldown dependem de acertar skillshots bloqueáveis; frontline e minions alteram alvo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.

mechanics.label: Blink ou teleporte instantâneo
mechanics.note: Blink curto prioriza alvo marcado e atravessa terreno; grounding impede o cast, mas anti-dash comum não o interrompe.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit. Prioritizes enemies stuck with Essence Flux.

mechanics.label: Dano global ou semiglobal
mechanics.note: Projétil global atravessa unidades e afeta waves/lutas, mas é telegráfico e perde dano por alvo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ezreal winds up before firing a powerful barrage of energy that deals massive damage to each unit it passes through (damage is reduced for minions and non-epic monsters).

mechanics.label: Negação de visão
mechanics.note: Effigies combinam ward e sweeper após nível, habilitando medo fora de visão.
mechanics.officialSummary: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by scarecrow effigies.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Drain em área cura e executa no final; interrupção antes do último tick remove grande parte do valor.
mechanics.officialSummary: Fiddlesticks drains health from nearby enemies, dealing bonus execute damage at the end of the duration.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Canal fora de visão seguido de blink cria engage em área; visão e interrupção antes da chegada são counters.
mechanics.officialSummary: A murder of crows flock wildly around Fiddlesticks, dealing damage per second to all enemy units in the area.

mechanics.label: Parry reativo
mechanics.note: Nega todo dano/CC da janela e devolve stun se bloquear imobilização; previsibilidade e leitura mecânica decidem a matchup.
mechanics.officialSummary: Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.

mechanics.label: Dano verdadeiro estrutural
mechanics.note: Vitals causam dano verdadeiro percentual e exigem acesso direcional; parede e posicionamento escondem pontos.
mechanics.officialSummary: Fiora has revealed a Vital on this Champion. If she hits the Vital, she restores Health and gains Move Speed.

mechanics.label: Impede morte
mechanics.note: Completar Vitals ou matar o alvo cria cura em área, virando duelo em sustain coletivo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on an enemy champion and gains Move Speed while near them. If Fiora hits all four Vitals or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.

mechanics.label: Intargetabilidade
mechanics.note: Playful/Trickster nega habilidades e reposiciona; cooldown usado para dano abre janela de punição.
mechanics.officialSummary: Fizz hops into the air, landing gracefully upon his spear and becoming untargetable. From this position, Fizz can either slam the ground or choose to jump again before smashing back down.

mechanics.label: Amplificação contra alvo isolado ou marcado
mechanics.note: Peixe cresce com distância e entrega slow/knockup para o all-in; projétil e spell shield respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Fizz tosses a fish in a direction that attaches to any champion that touches it, slowing the target. After a short delay, a shark erupts from the ground, knocking up the target and knocking any nearby enemies aside. All enemies hit are dealt magic damage and slowed.

mechanics.label: Defesa especialmente eficiente contra magia
mechanics.note: Shield mágico e redução de dano durante a carga tornam Galio especialmente eficiente contra burst AP; dano físico e poke repetido contornam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Galio charges a defensive stance, moving slowly. Upon releasing the charge, Galio will taunt and damage nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Taunt em área exige Galio próximo e reduz mobilidade enquanto carrega; alcance e interrupção antes da entrada limitam a entrega.
mechanics.officialSummary: Galio charges a defensive stance, moving slowly. Upon releasing the charge, Galio will taunt and damage nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Proteção global
mechanics.note: Salta em aliado e concede defesa mágica antes do knockup; depende de aliado-âncora e pode ser interrompido durante o canal.
mechanics.officialSummary: Galio designates an ally's position as his landing spot, granting all allies in the area a magic shield. After a delay Galio smashes down location, knocking up nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Limpeza de controle
mechanics.note: Remove controle e cura; reduz muito o valor de uma única iniciação, mas não impede reaplicação, knockups posteriores ou burst durante cooldown.
mechanics.officialSummary: Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health.

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Barril armazena dano, ignora parte da armadura e cria cadeia; inimigos à distância podem desarmar o objeto e quebrar a geometria.
mechanics.officialSummary: Gangplank uncovers a powder keg at target location. If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area, slowing them.

mechanics.label: Dano global ou semiglobal
mechanics.note: Zona global de slow e dano influencia qualquer luta e corta retirada, sem exigir que Gangplank abandone a side.
mechanics.officialSummary: Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area, slowing and damaging enemies.

mechanics.label: Redução extrema de dano
mechanics.note: Janela inicial reduz muito dano e concede tenacidade; premiar o timing errado ou prolongar a troca reduz sua eficiência.
mechanics.officialSummary: Garen passively increases his Armor and Magic Resist by killing enemies. He may also activate this ability to give him a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction for a longer duration.

mechanics.label: Silêncio
mechanics.note: Ataque fortalecido remove slows e silencia, mas exige contato corpo a corpo e pode ser negado por kite, blind ou evasão.
mechanics.officialSummary: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.

mechanics.label: Execução
mechanics.note: Dano verdadeiro cresce com vida perdida; cura/escudo antes do impacto e negar alcance mudam o limiar.
mechanics.officialSummary: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Rage força janelas separadas de ranged poke e Mega Gnar; engage inimigo pode esperar a forma errada.
mechanics.officialSummary: While in combat Gnar generates Rage. At maximum Rage his next ability will transform him into Mega Gnar, granting increased survivability and access to new spells.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Deslocamento em área só atordoa e amplifica junto a terreno; parede criada por aliados aumenta confiabilidade.
mechanics.officialSummary: Mega Gnar throws everything around him in a chosen direction, dealing damage and slowing them. Any enemy that hits a wall is stunned and takes bonus damage.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Body Slam intercepta entradas e combina com Flash, mas para no primeiro alvo e requer alcance corporal.
mechanics.officialSummary: Gragas charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Explosive Cask separa carry, desfaz engage ou entrega alvo; direção errada também salva o inimigo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Gragas hurls his cask to a location, dealing damage and knocking back enemies caught in the blast radius.

mechanics.label: Redução extrema de dano
mechanics.note: Redução durante a animação absorve janela curta de burst, mas não resolve DPS prolongado.
mechanics.officialSummary: Gragas samples his latest brew for 1 second. After finishing, he becomes boisterous and belligerent, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received.

mechanics.label: Ataques com regra própria
mechanics.note: Pellets colidem com a primeira unidade e recarregam em duas munições; minions e frontline reduzem acesso ao alvo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Graves' shotgun has some unique properties. He must reload when he runs out of ammo. Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units. Non-champions struck by multiple bullets are knocked back.

mechanics.label: Negação de visão
mechanics.note: Smoke Screen remove visão dentro da área, quebrando ataques e habilidades direcionadas mesmo sem hard CC.
mechanics.officialSummary: Graves fires a smoke canister at the target area creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.

mechanics.label: Imunidade a ameaças externas
mechanics.note: Ameaças fora da névoa não podem atingi-la; composições de longo alcance precisam entrar no espaço dela ou esperar a janela.
mechanics.officialSummary: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

mechanics.label: Dano verdadeiro estrutural
mechanics.note: Centro do corte converte dano em verdadeiro e aplica a passiva; deslocar Gwen ou sair do centro reduz drasticamente o resultado.
mechanics.officialSummary: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip.

mechanics.label: Dano percentual de vida
mechanics.note: Dano percentual e cura dão resposta natural a muita vida, condicionados a contato contínuo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Gwen's attacks deal bonus magic damage based on the targets health. She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Carga point-and-click empurra conforme a direção de contato; terreno e peel podem fazê-lo entregar o alvo para o lado errado.
mechanics.officialSummary: Hecarim gains increasing Move Speed and can move through units for a short duration. His next attack knocks the target back and deals additional physical damage based on the distance he has traveled since activating the ability.

mechanics.label: Imparável durante ação
mechanics.note: A carga é imparável e atravessa a frontline; o fear ocorre na onda final, então posicionamento ainda determina quem é controlado.
mechanics.officialSummary: Hecarim summons spectral riders and charges forward, dealing magic damage in a line. Hecarim creates a shockwave when he finishes his charge, causing nearby enemies to flee in terror.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: Torres criam território e DPS automático; deslocar a luta, limpar objetos ou isolar Heimer remove a base do kit.
mechanics.officialSummary: Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers).

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Grande parte do dano e do beam depende de torres preparadas e habilidades acertadas na área.
mechanics.officialSummary: Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers).

mechanics.label: Arsenal de habilidades selecionável
mechanics.note: Ultimate escolhe uma versão ampliada de Q/W/E: zona, burst de alcance ou controle repetido conforme a necessidade.
mechanics.officialSummary: Heimerdinger invents an upgrade, causing his next spell to have increased effects.

mechanics.label: Arsenal de habilidades selecionável
mechanics.note: Três opções de dano cobrem poke, vida máxima e zona; usar uma bloqueia as demais até o cooldown.
mechanics.officialSummary: Hwei envisions a series of disasters, allowing him to paint a devastating blow.This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with damaging abilities: Devastating Fire, Severing Bolt, and Molten Fissure.

mechanics.label: Arsenal de habilidades selecionável
mechanics.note: Escolhe fear de linha, zona anti-avanço ou pull; ferramenta correta depende da trajetória inimiga.
mechanics.officialSummary: Hwei envisions a series of torments, allowing him to paint controlling visages.This ability replaces Hwei's abilities with crowd control abilities: Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, and Crushing Maw.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: Tentáculos são objetos persistentes que definem dano e cura; lutar fora deles reduz muito o stat-check.
mechanics.officialSummary: Illaoi and the Vessels she creates spawn Tentacles on nearby impassible terrain. Tentacles swing at spirits, Vessels, and victims of Illaoi's Harsh lesson. Tentacles deal physical damage to enemies hit, and will heal Illaoi if they damage a champion.

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Spirit permite causar dano ao campeão por um proxy estacionário; minions bloqueiam e range quebra o tether.
mechanics.officialSummary: Illaoi rips the spirit from a foe's body, forcing it to stand before her. Spirits echo a percentage of the damage they take to the original target. If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel and begin spawning Tentacles.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Quanto mais campeões e espíritos próximos, mais tentáculos; isolamento, disengage e Mordekaiser R retiram seu ecossistema.
mechanics.officialSummary: Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies. A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Dash reseta em alvo marcado ou abatido; wave e marcas funcionam como rede de acesso, enquanto anti-dash quebra a sequência.
mechanics.officialSummary: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself. If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.

mechanics.label: Redução extrema de dano
mechanics.note: Canal reduz dano físico muito mais que mágico e fixa Irelia no lugar; CC não interrompe, mas zona e magia punem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.

mechanics.label: Habilidade vinculada a aliado
mechanics.note: Root cria uma rota de dash para Ivern e aliados até o alcance de ataque; pode facilitar entrada de melees ou expô-los.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ivern conjures a vine, dealing damage and rooting enemy targets hit. Ivern's allies can dash to the rooted target.

mechanics.label: Criação de terreno
mechanics.note: Cria arbusto e altera visão/auto range; também pode ocultar inimigos e deve ser avaliado pela geometria.
mechanics.officialSummary: In brush, Ivern and his nearby allies attacks deal bonus magic damage. Ivern can activate this ability to create a patch of brush.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: Daisy é frontline controlável e aplica knockup após ataques; Smite, burst e isolamento reduzem seu valor.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ivern summons his Sentinel friend Daisy to fight with him. Re-cast command Daisy to attack or move.

mechanics.label: Bloqueio de trajetória
mechanics.note: Tornado carregado cobre uma linha e interrompe dashes; é forte em trajetórias previsíveis, mas lento sem preparação.
mechanics.officialSummary: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Knockback imediato reseta engage e depois canaliza cura; interrupção posterior remove sustain, não o afastamento inicial.
mechanics.officialSummary: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.

mechanics.label: Criação de terreno
mechanics.note: Arena prende alvos sem dash sobre parede, mas pode aprisionar aliados e é removível pelo próprio Jarvan.
mechanics.officialSummary: Jarvan IV heroically leaps into battle at a target with such force that he terraforms the surrounding area to create an arena around them. Nearby enemies are damaged at the moment of impact.

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Knockup e dash surgem apenas ao conectar Q à bandeira; negar a linha ou separar cooldowns remove engage.
mechanics.officialSummary: Jarvan IV extends his lance, dealing physical damage and lowering the Armor of enemies in its path. Additionally, this will pull Jarvan to his Demacian Standard, knocking up enemies in his path.

mechanics.label: Evasão de ataques
mechanics.note: Ignora ataques e reduz dano de habilidades em área antes do stun; excelente contra on-hit, bem menos contra spell DPS.
mechanics.officialSummary: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.

mechanics.label: Habilidade vinculada a aliado
mechanics.note: Salta em unidades aliadas, inimigas ou wards; disponibilidade de âncoras muda acesso e fuga.
mechanics.officialSummary: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Alterna range/poke e forma melee com resistências, burst e disengage; forma errada abre janela clara.
mechanics.officialSummary: Hammer Stance: Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon gaining new abilities and increased range. The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.Cannon Stance: Transforms the Mercury Cannon into the Mercury Hammer gaining new abilities and increasing Armor and Magic Resist. The first attack in this form deals additional magic damage.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Martelo afasta point-and-click e interrompe entrada, exigindo contato corporal.
mechanics.officialSummary: Hammer Stance: Deals magic damage to an enemy and knocks them back a short distance.Cannon Stance: Deploys an Acceleration Gate increasing the Move Speed of all allied champions who pass through it. If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.

mechanics.label: Aumento excepcional de alcance
mechanics.note: Acceleration Gate amplia velocidade e alcance prático do Shock Blast e acelera aliados.
mechanics.officialSummary: Hammer Stance: Deals magic damage to an enemy and knocks them back a short distance.Cannon Stance: Deploys an Acceleration Gate increasing the Move Speed of all allied champions who pass through it. If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.

mechanics.label: Ataques com regra própria
mechanics.note: Quatro tiros, recarga fixa e AS convertido em dano tornam sua cadência previsível; divers exploram a janela e Jhin não produz DPS contínuo comum.
mechanics.officialSummary: Jhin's hand cannon, Whisper, is a precise instrument designed to deal superior damage. It fires at a fixed rate and carries only four shots. Jhin imbues the final bullet with dark magics to critically strike and deal bonus execute damage. Whenever Whisper crits, it inspires Jhin with a burst of Move Speed.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Root longo só ocorre após dano prévio de Jhin/aliado e continua sendo projétil estreito; é follow-up, não engage confiável isolado.
mechanics.officialSummary: Jhin brandishes his cane, firing a single shot with incredible range. It pierces through minions and monsters, but stops on the first champion hit. If the target was recently struck by Jhin's allies, lotus traps, or damaged by Jhin, they are rooted.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Quatro tiros de enorme alcance exigem linha e proteção; dive, flanco e frontline bloqueando anulam a janela.
mechanics.officialSummary: Jhin channels, transforming Whisper into a shoulder-mounted mega-cannon. It is able to fire 4 super shots at extreme range that pierce through minions and monsters, but stop on the first champion impacted. Whisper cripples enemies hit, which slows them and deals execute damage. The 4th shot is perfectly crafted, epically powerful, and guaranteed to critically strike.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Estruturas, campeões e monstros épicos abatidos dão velocidade/AS e permitem encadear luta e objetivo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Jinx receives massively increased Move Speed and Attack Speed whenever she helps kill or destroy an enemy champions epic jungle monster, or structure.

mechanics.label: Armadilhas e preparação de terreno
mechanics.note: Chompers criam parede curta que enraíza após armar; excelente follow-up, fraca como resposta instantânea no corpo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Jinx throws out a line of snare grenades that explode after 5 seconds, lighting enemies on fire. Flame Chompers will bite enemy champions who walk over them, rooting them in place.

mechanics.label: Dano global ou semiglobal
mechanics.note: Foguete escala com distância e vida perdida, mas para no primeiro campeão e pode ser interceptado.
mechanics.officialSummary: Jinx fires a super rocket across the map that gains damage as it travels. The rocket will explode upon colliding with an enemy champion, dealing damage to it and surrounding enemies based on their missing Health.

mechanics.label: Imparável durante ação
mechanics.note: Durante a preparação fica imparável e reduz dano; direção e tempo são telegráficos e ele perde distância se interromper cedo.
mechanics.officialSummary: K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies.When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.

mechanics.label: Isolamento de alvo
mechanics.note: Empurra o alvo através de parede e separa a luta; sem terreno perde alcance e K'Sante sacrifica vida/resistências.
mechanics.officialSummary: K'Sante knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path. Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: All Out troca defesa por dano/mobilidade, então a mesma entrada pode ser ótima para matar e péssima para sobreviver.
mechanics.officialSummary: K'Sante knocks an enemy back, launching them through any wall in their path. Then, K'Sante goes All Out and dashes after them, gaining increased damage, healing, and transformed abilities at the cost of reduced defenses.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Dash de longo alcance só pode ir ao redor de inimigo marcado por plasma; aliado com hard CC aumenta muito a entrega.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kai'Sa dashes near an enemy champion.

mechanics.label: Amplificação contra alvo isolado ou marcado
mechanics.note: Mísseis distribuem entre alvos próximos; isolamento concentra dano, wave e summons diluem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kai'Sa shoots a swarm of missiles that seek out nearby targets.Living Weapon: Icathian Rain is upgraded to shoot more missiles.

mechanics.label: Ataques com regra própria
mechanics.note: Cada ataque permite salto, mas slows reduzem distância/ritmo e o dano do auto tem regra própria; anti-dash e AS slow são excepcionais.
mechanics.officialSummary: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.

mechanics.label: Execução ou segurança de objetivo
mechanics.note: Rend acumula lanças sem limite prático e reseta ao executar; segurança cresce com tempo livre batendo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Attacks impale their targets with spears. Activate to rip the spears out, slowing and dealing escalating damage.

mechanics.label: Retirada ou proteção direta de aliado
mechanics.note: Puxa o aliado vinculado para intargetabilidade e permite que ele se arremesse; separação e vínculo escolhido limitam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kalista teleports the Oathsworn ally to herself. They gain the ability to dash toward a position, knocking enemy champions back.

mechanics.label: Arsenal de habilidades selecionável
mechanics.note: Mantra transforma Q em poke/zone, W em sustain prolongado e E em mobilidade/escudo coletivo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.

mechanics.label: Vínculo que pune afastamento tardio
mechanics.note: Root exige manter vínculo por toda duração; mobilidade e range quebram, aproximação sem saída é punida.
mechanics.officialSummary: Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again.Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.

mechanics.label: Atuação após a morte
mechanics.note: Continua lançando por alguns segundos após morrer e torna-se inalvejável; matar no centro da equipe ainda pode favorecer Karthus.
mechanics.officialSummary: Upon dying, Karthus enters a spirit form that allows him to continue casting spells.

mechanics.label: Dano global ou semiglobal
mechanics.note: Dano global em todos os vivos após canal; stasis, escudo, cura e interrupção antes da morte respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: After channeling for 3 seconds, Karthus deals damage to all enemy champions.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: O canal visível cria janela de interrupção se Karthus estiver vivo e acessível.
mechanics.officialSummary: After channeling for 3 seconds, Karthus deals damage to all enemy champions.

mechanics.label: Blink ou teleporte instantâneo
mechanics.note: Blink de cooldown baixo acumula custo e dano; mana e grounding limitam reposicionamentos, anti-dash comum não interrompe.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana but also deal additional damage.

mechanics.label: Defesa especialmente eficiente contra magia
mechanics.note: Redução de dano mágico e ghosting favorecem lanes AP e trânsito por wave; matchups AD ignoram a principal defesa.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Takedowns reduzem drasticamente cooldowns e permitem limpar lutas; negar o primeiro abate é mais valioso que CC tardio.
mechanics.officialSummary: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Adagas no chão definem dano e rotas de Shunpo; zonear o ponto de queda prevê a próxima posição.
mechanics.officialSummary: Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

mechanics.label: Blink ou teleporte instantâneo
mechanics.note: Shunpo teleporta para unidade ou adaga; grounding impede o cast, enquanto anti-dash comum não interrompe o deslocamento.
mechanics.officialSummary: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Ultimate em área é interrompida por hard CC/silêncio e exige entrada corporal.
mechanics.officialSummary: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Níveis 6/11/16 alteram alcance e área; pressão precoce e tempo de escala mudam completamente o draft.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points. Her wings are lit aflame as she progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire on her attacks.

mechanics.label: Invulnerabilidade
mechanics.note: Torna a si ou aliado invulnerável e depois causa dano em área; força espera e nega execução.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kayle makes an ally invulnerable and calls upon former Aspects of Justice to purify the area around her target with a holy rain of swords.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Rhaast e Shadow Assassin respondem a frontline/sustain ou backline frágil; a forma precisa ser tratada como variante.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kayn wields an ancient weapon and fights Rhaast, the darkin within it, for control. Either the Darkin will triumph, or Kayn will master Rhaast and become the Shadow Assassin.Darkin: Heal for a percentage of spell damage dealt to champions.Shadow Assassin: For the first few seconds in combat with enemy champions, deal bonus damage.

mechanics.label: Travessia de terreno
mechanics.note: Move-se por paredes e cura, tornando visão e rotas tradicionais menos confiáveis; dano/CC encurtam a travessia.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kayn can walk through terrain.

mechanics.label: Intargetabilidade
mechanics.note: Entra em alvo previamente danificado e fica inalvejável; stasis/torre/aliados podem preparar a saída.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kayn hides in an enemy's body, dealing massive damage when he bursts out.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Três marcas atordoam; aplicações vêm de fontes distintas e a terceira pode ser preparada, mas não é controle instantâneo do zero.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Tempestade móvel aplica múltiplas marcas em área; precisa entrar, sofre com disengage e domina comps agrupadas.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.

mechanics.label: Amplificação contra alvo isolado ou marcado
mechanics.note: Dano aumenta em alvo isolado; minions, aliados e summons próximos removem a condição.
mechanics.officialSummary: Deals physical damage to the target. Damage increased on Isolated targets. If he chooses to Evolve Reaper Claws, this refunds a percent of it's cooldown against Isolated targets. Kha'Zix also gains increased range on his basic attacks and Taste Their Fear.

mechanics.label: Invisibilidade
mechanics.note: Invisibilidade repetida quebra seleção e reposiciona; revelação e dano em área reduzem janela.
mechanics.officialSummary: Each rank allows Kha'Zix to evolve one of his abilities, giving it a unique additional effect. When activated, Kha'Zix becomes Invisible, triggering Unseen Threat and increasing Move Speed. If he chooses to Evolve Adaptive Cloaking, Void Assault gains increased Invisibility duration, and an additional use.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Com evolução, abates resetam o salto e permitem limpar backline; sem primeiro takedown a saída falta.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kha'Zix leaps to an area, dealing physical damage upon landing. If he chooses to Evolve Wings, Leap's range increases by 200 and the cooldown resets on champion kill or assist.

mechanics.label: Escalonamento infinito
mechanics.note: Marcas aumentam alcance e habilidades; a rota de caça é pública e contestável.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kindred can mark targets to Hunt. Successfully completing a Hunt permanently empowers Kindred's basic abilities. Every 4 hunts completed also increases Kindred's basic attack range.

mechanics.label: Impede morte
mechanics.note: Todos dentro da área, inclusive inimigos, não podem morrer e são curados ao final; displacement e timing decidem quem ganha.
mechanics.officialSummary: Lamb grants all living things inside a zone a respite from death. Until the effect ends, nothing can die. At the end, units are healed.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Desmonta em vez de morrer e pode remontar por coragem; burst na forma desmontada nega a segunda barra.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kled rides his trusty steed, Skaarl, who takes damage for him. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts.While dismounted, Kled's abilities change and he deals less damage to champions. Kled can restore Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies. At maximum courage, Kled remounts with a portion of Skaarl's health.

mechanics.label: Entrada global ou semiglobal
mechanics.note: Carga semiglobal cria caminho e persegue o primeiro campeão encontrado; trajetórias e interceptação da frontline importam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kled and Skaarl charge to a location, leaving a speed-granting trail behind them and gaining a shield. Skaarl locks onto and rams the first enemy champion encountered.

mechanics.label: Atuação após a morte
mechanics.note: Após morrer ganha velocidade e explode em dano verdadeiro; espaçar depois do abate evita troca gratuita.
mechanics.officialSummary: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.

mechanics.label: Dano percentual de vida
mechanics.note: Alcance e dano mágico percentual durante janela limitada destroem frontline; dive e espera do cooldown respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit.

mechanics.label: Clone e engano
mechanics.note: Ao ficar baixa cria clone e invisibilidade curta; AoE, reveal e leitura de movimento reduzem engano.
mechanics.officialSummary: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

mechanics.label: Retorno forçado a uma posição
mechanics.note: Dash deixa âncora para retorno opcional; zona persistente e CC atrasado podem punir exatamente a saída.
mechanics.officialSummary: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.

mechanics.label: Vínculo que pune afastamento tardio
mechanics.note: Corrente precisa conectar e manter alcance para enraizar; minions bloqueiam o projétil e mobilidade quebra vínculo.
mechanics.officialSummary: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Segundo Q acompanha o alvo marcado e escala com vida perdida; pode levar Lee a counter-engage ou stasis.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

mechanics.label: Habilidade vinculada a aliado
mechanics.note: Dash em aliado/ward oferece rota de fuga ou reposicionamento; negar wards/âncoras reduz segurança.
mechanics.officialSummary: Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Kick point-and-click desloca um alvo e knockupa os atravessados; posição relativa vale mais que dano.
mechanics.officialSummary: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Projétil atravessa minions e leva Leona ao último campeão atingido; pode ser usado contra ela ao puxá-la para zona ruim.
mechanics.officialSummary: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Stun por ataque é confiável depois que Leona toca o alvo; range/peel são a defesa real.
mechanics.officialSummary: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Centro atordoa e borda desacelera; follow-up aumenta confiabilidade, cast isolado é desviável.
mechanics.officialSummary: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

mechanics.label: Dano percentual de vida
mechanics.note: Habilidades aplicam burn percentual e cura; exige acertos repetidos e espaço para orbitar.
mechanics.officialSummary: Hitting a champion or monster with a skill will deal additional max Health damage over time.

mechanics.label: Sono e amplificação do próximo dano
mechanics.note: Pode adormecer à distância todos marcados pela passiva; cleanse, spell shield e não ser atingido antes quebram setup.
mechanics.officialSummary: Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep. Those enemies will take extra damage on being forcibly woken up.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: No inimigo é stun point-and-click; em si mesma é stasis e cura. A escolha muda engage, anti-dive e sobrevivência.
mechanics.officialSummary: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable. Dark ice then emanates from the target dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing Move Speed.

mechanics.label: Stasis
mechanics.note: Autocast nega burst e cria zona; o inimigo pode esperar e cercar a saída.
mechanics.officialSummary: If cast on an enemy champion, the target is frozen solid, stunning it. If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable. Dark ice then emanates from the target dealing magic damage to enemies and slowing Move Speed.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: Inimigos mortos próximos viram thralls explosivos, aumentando muito luta em sequência e espaços apertados.
mechanics.officialSummary: When an enemy champion dies near Lissandra they become a Frozen Thrall. Frozen Thralls slow nearby enemies and then, after a delay, shatter from the intense cold, dealing magic damage to nearby targets.

mechanics.label: Blink ou teleporte instantâneo
mechanics.note: Recast teleporta Lissandra à garra; o destino é visível e pode ser preparado com CC ou zona.
mechanics.officialSummary: Lissandra creates an ice claw that deals magic damage. Reactivating this ability transports Lissandra to the claw's current location.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Teleporta e então atravessa o próximo alvo, criando acesso condicionado e posição final previsível.
mechanics.officialSummary: Locke teleports to a location before dashing to attack his next target, dealing damage to enemies passed through.

mechanics.label: Execução
mechanics.note: Artefato vincula, causa dano e pode selar campeões em limiar, concedendo poder adicional; negar a finalização limita escala.
mechanics.officialSummary: Locke throws a binding artifact that deals damage and potentially executes enemies hit. Locke gains additional power for sealing away enemy champions.

mechanics.label: Ataques com regra própria
mechanics.note: Após habilidade dispara dois ataques e interage com buffs aliados; blind/evasão e falta de janela corporal reduzem combo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot. When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Rajada de projéteis em uma direção permite mover, mas é bloqueada por unidades e interrompida por CC.
mechanics.officialSummary: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.

mechanics.label: Polimorfia
mechanics.note: Point-and-click remove ataque e habilidades do diver; alcance curto significa que Lulu deve estar próxima do alvo protegido.
mechanics.officialSummary: If cast on an ally, grants them Attack Speed and Move Speed for a short time. If cast on an enemy, turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells.

mechanics.label: Retirada ou proteção direta de aliado
mechanics.note: Concede vida, knockup e slow ao redor do aliado sem ser projétil; excelente contra commit corporal.
mechanics.officialSummary: Lulu enlarges an ally, knocking nearby enemies into the air and granting the ally a large amount of bonus health. For the next few seconds, that ally gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Revelação e visão verdadeira
mechanics.note: Pix acompanha inimigo e concede visão verdadeira, reduzindo stealth e clone deception.
mechanics.officialSummary: If cast on an ally, commands Pix to jump to an ally and shield them. He then follows them and aids their attacks. If cast on an enemy, commands Pix to jump to an enemy and damage them. He then follows them and grants you vision of that enemy.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Root acerta até dois alvos, mas minions consomem um e projétil pode ser desviado/negado.
mechanics.officialSummary: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Área revela, desacelera e pode ser mantida para negar corredor antes da explosão.
mechanics.officialSummary: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.

mechanics.label: Redução de velocidade de ataque
mechanics.note: Ground Slam reduz AS em área e é excepcional contra auto-attackers que precisam entrar.
mechanics.officialSummary: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.

mechanics.label: Imparável durante ação
mechanics.note: Dash imparável em área ignora peel durante a trajetória, mas ainda depende de alcance e pode ser antecipado por Flash/stasis.
mechanics.officialSummary: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

mechanics.label: Escudo de habilidade
mechanics.note: Bloqueia dano e CC até ser removido; poke barato abre janela antes do all-in.
mechanics.officialSummary: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.

mechanics.label: Supressão
mechanics.note: Supressão point-and-click trava um alvo, mas também canaliza Malzahar; range, QSS e interrupção do caster respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: Voidlings aumentam shove e bloqueiam skillshots, porém morrem para AoE e isolamento.
mechanics.officialSummary: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Intargetabilidade
mechanics.note: Durante o dash point-and-click fica inalvejável e acompanha movimento do alvo; pode ser levado para posição ruim.
mechanics.officialSummary: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.

mechanics.label: Armadilhas e preparação de terreno
mechanics.note: Saplings dão visão e zona, amplificados em arbusto; sweeper e summons absorvem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Raízes largas avançam lentamente e são bloqueadas por campeões; ótima cobertura, baixa surpresa sem flanco.
mechanics.officialSummary: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.

mechanics.label: Intargetabilidade
mechanics.note: Alpha Strike evita alvo durante a animação e termina próximo da unidade; timing de CC/zona na saída é decisivo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.

mechanics.label: Redução extrema de dano
mechanics.note: Meditate reduz dano e cura enquanto canaliza; hard CC interrompe e dano verdadeiro reduz vantagem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time. In addition, Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike and pause the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander for each second he channels.

mechanics.label: Imunidade a slows
mechanics.note: Ignora slows e ganha resets parciais em takedown; hard CC e terreno substituem kite por slow.
mechanics.officialSummary: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.

mechanics.label: Reflexão de projéteis
mechanics.note: Reflete projéteis hostis, previne dano e acelera Mel; habilidades centrais refletíveis podem inverter completamente a matchup.
mechanics.officialSummary: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Zona enraíza no centro e desacelera ao redor, protegendo espaço contra entrada previsível.
