mechanics.officialSummary: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.

mechanics.label: Dano global ou semiglobal
mechanics.note: Detona Overwhelm em todos os inimigos marcados, transformando poke distribuído em alcance global condicional.
mechanics.officialSummary: Mel strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her, dealing additional damage for each stack of Overwhelm.Ranks of Golden Eclipse increase Overwhelm's damage.

mechanics.label: Aumento excepcional de alcance
mechanics.note: Aumenta alcance de ataque de aliados dentro da fogueira, mudando quem consegue tocar a frontline sem entrar no engage.
mechanics.officialSummary: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.

mechanics.label: Limpeza de controle
mechanics.note: Cura e limpa CC de aliados em grande área, mas Milio precisa não estar controlado e não remove todas as categorias.
mechanics.officialSummary: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Projétil empurra o primeiro inimigo e explode atrás; minions podem virar ferramenta ou bloqueio.
mechanics.officialSummary: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Bounce usa ângulo da primeira unidade e pode critar ao abater; posicionamento atrás da wave cria lane muito diferente.
mechanics.officialSummary: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Cone enorme de dano exige canal protegido; qualquer interrupção ou saída lateral corta grande parte do valor.
mechanics.officialSummary: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike

mechanics.label: Isolamento em outra dimensão
mechanics.note: Remove alvo e Mordekaiser da luta, levando apenas entidades da dimensão correspondente; desmonta protetores, summons, zonas e setup externo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

mechanics.label: Roubo de atributos
mechanics.note: Rouba atributos do alvo durante o duelo e os mantém até reviver se matar; comps sem dano de duelo não conseguem resgatar o escolhido.
mechanics.officialSummary: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

mechanics.label: Amplificação contra alvo isolado ou marcado
mechanics.note: Obliterate causa mais dano quando atinge apenas um alvo; wave e summons diluem na lane.
mechanics.officialSummary: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.

mechanics.label: Escudo de habilidade
mechanics.note: Bloqueia dano mágico e CC enquanto existir; dano físico não remove, poke mágico prepara a quebra.
mechanics.officialSummary: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Root muito longo, porém projétil lento e bloqueável; setup e corredores elevam confiabilidade.
mechanics.officialSummary: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.

mechanics.label: Vínculo que pune afastamento tardio
mechanics.note: Correntes em área precisam permanecer conectadas para stun; stasis/mobilidade ajudam Morgana, disengage quebra.
mechanics.officialSummary: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground. She lashes chains of dark pain onto nearby enemy champions, gaining Move Speed. The chains slow and deal initial damage and, after a delay, stun those who are unable to break them.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: Cães bloqueiam skillshots e ampliam dano, mas AoE os remove e abre janela antes do respawn.
mechanics.officialSummary: Naafiri spawns packmates that attack the targets of her attacks and abilities.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Dash direcionado pode ser interceptado por outro campeão e tem canal visível; frontline e peel decidem a entrega.
mechanics.officialSummary: Naafiri becomes Untargetable and empowers her pack, spawning additional packmates and gaining increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Ultimate concede pack, visão e shield que pode renovar no primeiro takedown; negar a primeira kill reduz muito o snowball.
mechanics.officialSummary: Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, dealing damage. Naafiri reveals nearby enemies if she scores a takedown and can recast this Ability once. The second cast grants a shield.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Bolha suspende em área, mas tem atraso alto e funciona melhor como follow-up ou em trajetória forçada.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Onda larga atravessa a luta e acelera aliados tocados; projétil lento permite reposicionamento lateral.
mechanics.officialSummary: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies. Allies hit gain double the effect of Surging Tides.

mechanics.label: Escalonamento infinito
mechanics.note: Last hits acumulam dano sem limite, tornando negação de wave e tempo de jogo componentes centrais.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.

mechanics.label: Redução de velocidade de ataque
mechanics.note: Wither point-and-click aplica slow crescente e redução de AS, excepcional contra carries sem cleanse ou dash.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.

mechanics.label: Dano percentual de vida
mechanics.note: Zona corporal de vida máxima, resistências e Q acelerado transforma duelo prolongado; kite nega tudo simultaneamente.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, damages nearby enemies, has a reduced cooldown on Siphoning Strike, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Primeiro auto em cada alvo enraíza; confiável após contato, inútil sem acesso.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals increased physical damage and roots them briefly.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Hook colide com terreno e unidades; parede pode servir de mobilidade, minion/summon protege carry.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. Colliding with an enemy pulls them and Nautilus together, dealing magic damage. Colliding with terrain pulls Nautilus towards it.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Ultimate point-and-click persegue e knockupa o alvo, também atingindo quem cruza; range inicial ainda limita cast.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nautilus fires a shockwave into the earth that chases an opponent. This shockwave rips up the earth above it, knocking enemies into the air. When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.

mechanics.label: Clone e engano
mechanics.note: Disfarça-se como aliado, minion ou unidade e altera informação de draft em campo; dano/reveal quebram.
mechanics.officialSummary: Neeko can look like an ally champion or as other units on the map. Receiving immobilizing crowd control, casting damaging spells, damaging enemy towers as a non-champion, or your disguise taking damage equal to its healthbar breaks the disguise.

mechanics.label: Clone e engano
mechanics.note: Clone e invisibilidade curta criam rota falsa e podem bloquear projétil.
mechanics.officialSummary: Neeko passively deals bonus magic damage every third attack, briefly increasing her move speed. Neeko can activate to send a clone in a direction and recast to change the direction of the clone.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Salto/knockup em área pode ocultar preparação pelo disfarce; precisa entrar e sofre contra spacing.
mechanics.officialSummary: After a short preparation, Neeko leaps into the air, knocking up all nearby enemies. Upon landing, nearby enemies are damaged and stunned. The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Forma humana entrega poke/cura; cougar converte marca em acesso e execute. Sem spear/trap, entrada perde alcance.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities.

mechanics.label: Amplificação contra alvo isolado ou marcado
mechanics.note: Javelin cresce com distância e é bloqueável; corredores e CC aliado aumentam muito o valor.
mechanics.officialSummary: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies. As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.

mechanics.label: Armadilhas e preparação de terreno
mechanics.note: Armadilha revela e marca, preparando cougar e visão de flanco; sweeper e frontline absorvem.
mechanics.officialSummary: In human form, Nidalee lays a trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages and reveals its target. As a cougar, she jumps in a direction, dealing damage in an area where she lands.

mechanics.label: Evasão de ataques
mechanics.note: Evita ataques e reduz dano mágico, podendo compartilhar a aliados tocados; spell damage físico ainda conecta.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nilah envelops herself in mist, increasing her movement speed and allowing her to gracefully dodge all incoming attacks. Any allies she touches during the mist's duration will also gain this effect.

mechanics.label: Amplificação de cura e escudo
mechanics.note: Amplifica cura/escudo recebido e compartilha sustain, tornando enchanters mais valiosos.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nilah gains increased experience from last-hitting minions along with the ability to enhance and share nearby healing and shielding from her allies.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Canal corporal puxa inimigos e cura; precisa sobreviver na entrada e pode ser afastada/interrompida.
mechanics.officialSummary: Twirling her whip-blade in joyful exuberance, Nilah deals damage to enemies around her before pulling them closer with her weapon.

mechanics.label: Escudo de habilidade
mechanics.note: Bloqueia uma habilidade e concede AS se acionado; poke/isca remove antes do controle central.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.

mechanics.label: Negação de visão
mechanics.note: Remove visão e comunicação espacial inimiga durante a janela, quebrando saves e follow-up mesmo sem usar o dash.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

mechanics.label: Entrada global ou semiglobal
mechanics.note: Dash direcionado a um campeão visto ignora frontline entre origem e alvo, mas pode ser recebido por peel no destino.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

mechanics.label: Execução ou segurança de objetivo
mechanics.note: Consume combina dano verdadeiro e cura, oferecendo segurança excepcional em Smite fight se Nunu toca o objetivo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself.

mechanics.label: Bloqueio de trajetória
mechanics.note: Snowball exige rota contínua e curva limitada; paredes, terreno criado e interrupção frontal quebram engage.
mechanics.officialSummary: Willump creates a snowball that grows in size and speed as he rolls it. The snowball damages and knocks up enemies.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Canal em área desacelera e causa burst máximo no fim; hard CC, deslocamento e saída rápida são respostas diretas.
mechanics.officialSummary: Nunu & Willump create a powerful blizzard in an area that slows enemies and deals massive damage at the end.

mechanics.label: Imunidade a controle
mechanics.note: Remove CC e fica imune enquanto mantém combate; comps dependentes de controle não conseguem parar sua entrada.
mechanics.officialSummary: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

mechanics.label: Bloqueio de trajetória
mechanics.note: Machados repetidos mantêm slow se Olaf consegue recolhê-los; zonear o ponto de queda limita perseguição.
mechanics.officialSummary: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

mechanics.label: Dano verdadeiro estrutural
mechanics.note: Dano verdadeiro point-and-click ignora resistência e tem cooldown reduzido por ataques; kite nega repetição.
mechanics.officialSummary: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Todas as zonas principais partem da bola; acompanhar sua posição revela alcance real e setup.
mechanics.officialSummary: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Shockwave puxa em área ao redor da bola, incluindo bola carregada por diver aliado; separação e tracking respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Dash só knockupa ao colidir com terreno, inclusive criado por campeões; campo aberto reduz ameaça.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ornn charges, dealing damage to enemies he passes through. If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave around him which deals damage and knocks up enemies.

mechanics.label: Imparável durante ação
mechanics.note: Fica imparável durante o sopro e aplica Brittle; timing pode negar displacement previsível.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Primeira passagem aplica slow/Brittle e recast redireciona com knockup; wind wall/interrupção antes do recast anulam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ornn summons a massive elemental at a location which travels toward him with increasing speed. Enemies run over by the elemental take damage, are slowed and are made Brittle. Ornn can recast the ability to charge into the elemental, redirecting it in the direction he hits it, causing the elemental to affect any enemies it runs over to be knocked up, dealing the same damage and re-applying Brittle.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Stun point-and-click só é confiável dentro de alcance curto e após atravessar zoneamento/frontline; não deve contar contra backline inalcançável.
mechanics.officialSummary: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.

mechanics.label: Defesa direcional
mechanics.note: Nega dano vindo da direção encarada enquanto avança/recuа; flanco, espera e dano por trás contornam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.

mechanics.label: Entrada global ou semiglobal
mechanics.note: Canal semiglobal cria flanco telegráfico; CC aliado e rotas de retirada determinam conversão.
mechanics.officialSummary: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet.

mechanics.label: Interrupção de dash
mechanics.note: Interrompe dashes inimigos próximos e depois aplica grounding/slow; muda completamente campeões cuja entrada ou saída é dash.
mechanics.officialSummary: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.

mechanics.label: Grounding
mechanics.note: Após bloquear um dash, impede novo deslocamento por uma janela, quebrando sequências e resets.
mechanics.officialSummary: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Só atordoa ao empurrar contra parede, inclusive terreno criado; posição lateral é condição central.
mechanics.officialSummary: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Carga pode remover múltiplos inimigos da luta/objetivo; tap curto oferece knockup de peel.
mechanics.officialSummary: Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.

mechanics.label: Camuflagem
mechanics.note: Camuflagem acelera rotação e acesso, mas proximidade e control ward revelam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Pyke enters Camouflage and gains significant Move Speed that decays over time.

mechanics.label: Execução
mechanics.note: Executa abaixo do limiar, ignora shields no cálculo prático e reseta para sequência; cura/stasis acima do timing negam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Pyke blinks to and executes low health enemies, allowing him to cast this spell again and granting additional gold to an ally who assists.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Recast após execução pode limpar luta e gerar ouro extra; negar o primeiro X encerra cadeia.
mechanics.officialSummary: Pyke blinks to and executes low health enemies, allowing him to cast this spell again and granting additional gold to an ally who assists.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Elemento de terreno muda Q entre root, dano e stealth; mapa e posição definem arsenal disponível.
mechanics.officialSummary: Qiyana dashes to a location and enchants her weapon with an element. Her attacks and abilities deal bonus damage while her weapon is enchanted.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Empurra e detona ao longo de parede/rio/brush; longe dessas superfícies perde stun e grande parte do burst.
mechanics.officialSummary: Qiyana sends out a shockwave that detonates whatever elements she hits with it, stunning and damaging nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Invisibilidade
mechanics.note: Elemento de grama cria trilha de invisibilidade, permitindo esperar cooldown; AoE/reveal respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Qiyana swings her weapon, dealing damage with a bonus effect based on her element.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Vault point-and-click interrompe e reposiciona Quinn à distância de ataque; anti-dash ou CC na aterrissagem punem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away from the target.

mechanics.label: Entrada global ou semiglobal
mechanics.note: Velocidade fora de combate permite side/roam, mas dano cancela e a canalização abre janela.
mechanics.officialSummary: Quinn and Valor team up to fly around at great speed. Ending the ability casts Skystrike, which deals damage to nearby enemies and marks champions with Harrier.

mechanics.label: Revelação e visão verdadeira
mechanics.note: Pulso revela ampla área e reduz flancos/stealth por informação, não true sight persistente.
mechanics.officialSummary: Passively grants Quinn Attack Speed and Move Speed after she attacks a Harrier target. Activate to have Valor reveal a large area nearby.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Dash com knockup atrasado exige prever saída; Flash ou R aumenta confiabilidade, anti-dash quebra.
mechanics.officialSummary: Dashes to a location, knocking up nearby enemies on arrival.

mechanics.label: Habilidade vinculada a aliado
mechanics.note: Dois dashes em aliados dão entrada e saída; separação e falta de âncora o prendem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Flies to an allied champion granting them a shield. Can be re-cast for free for a short duration.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Charme por contato e velocidade permite cobrir vários, mas exige caminho corporal e não reaplica no mesmo alvo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Gains Move Speed, charming and dealing magic damage to enemies touched.

mechanics.label: Reflexão ou devolução de dano
mechanics.note: Defesa e retorno de dano por ataque punem auto-attackers, especialmente hits rápidos; AP/spell DPS contorna.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, and returning damage to enemies that attack him.

mechanics.label: Redução de velocidade de ataque
mechanics.note: Taunt point-and-click força ataques e reduz AS depois; alcance corporal e cleanse limitam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him.

mechanics.label: Bloqueio de trajetória
mechanics.note: Powerball ganha velocidade mas colide com unidades; minion/summon e terreno criado interceptam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Burrow troca visão normal por tremor e habilita knockup; unidades imóveis somem do sensor e reveal funciona diferente.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Portal de terreno
mechanics.note: Túneis persistem como rede de mobilidade e podem ser destruídos pelo inimigo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Salta ao alvo marcado, fica inalvejável durante parte da animação e executa por vida perdida; stasis nega chegada.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rek'Sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their maximum health.

mechanics.label: Roubo de atributos
mechanics.note: Ataques/habilidades roubam Armor/MR e transferem valor ao foco aliado; múltiplos alvos acumulam frontline.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rell's Attacks and Abilities deal additional magic damage and steal Armor and Magic Resist on hit.

mechanics.label: Quebra de escudo
mechanics.note: Quebra todos os escudos antes do dano/stun, alterando diretamente drafts de enchanter.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rell deals magic damage to units in a line, breaking their shields and stunning them.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Mount/dismount alterna engage com knockup e forma lenta resistente; errar entrada deixa Rell sem saída.
mechanics.officialSummary: Mounted: Rell Dismounts, crashing down in her armor, Knocking enemies up and gaining a large Shield. While dismounted, she gains Armor, Magic Resist, Attack Speed, and Attack Range, but is Slowed.Dismounted: Rell forms her Mount, gaining a burst of speed and Knocking Up the next enemy she attacks.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Campo puxa continuamente sem interromper ações, compactando inimigos para follow-up.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rell explodes in a magnetic fury, violently Pulling nearby enemies toward herself. Then Rell constantly Drags nearby enemies toward herself for a short while, dealing magic damage over time.

mechanics.label: Impede morte
mechanics.note: Aliado entra em estado de morte adiada e revive ao conseguir takedown; disengage inimigo nega o gatilho.
mechanics.officialSummary: Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death and potentially saving them if they get a takedown.

mechanics.label: Berserk entre inimigos
mechanics.note: Inimigos atingidos atacam aliados próprios; comps de auto e front-to-back agrupadas podem se destruir.
mechanics.officialSummary: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Root pode arremessar alvo e atordoar colisões; projétil e segundo comando criam condição dupla.
mechanics.officialSummary: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction.

mechanics.label: Quebra de escudo
mechanics.note: Versão fortalecida remove escudos antes do dano e stun, punindo defesas reativas.
mechanics.officialSummary: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Segundo dash existe após atravessar unidade e versão com Fury reduz Armor; wave habilita acesso/saída.
mechanics.officialSummary: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Vida instantânea e dano corporal ampliam all-in prolongado; kite remove zona e geração de Fury.
mechanics.officialSummary: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.

mechanics.label: Travessia de terreno
mechanics.note: Em arbusto, ataques saltam até o alvo; controlar brush e visão muda alcance real da lane/luta.
mechanics.officialSummary: While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack.Rengar generates Ferocity whenever he casts an ability. At Max Ferocity, his next ability is empowered.Killing enemy champions awards trophies on Rengar's Bonetooth Necklace, granting bonus attack damage.

mechanics.label: Limpeza de controle
mechanics.note: W fortalecido limpa CC e cura dano recente; CC repetido ou burst fora da janela responde.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rengar lets out a battle roar, damaging enemies and healing for some of the recent damage he has taken.Ferocity effect: additionally breaks crowd control effects.

mechanics.label: Camuflagem
mechanics.note: Camuflagem revela o inimigo mais próximo e habilita salto; frontline pode se oferecer como alvo de aproximação.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rengar's predatory instincts take over, Camouflaging him and revealing the nearest enemy champion in a large radius around him. During Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar gains Move Speed and he can leap to the tracked enemy without being in brush, reducing their armor.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Três casts de dash terminam em knockup; anti-dash e spacing quebram combo, mas recasts atravessam terreno situacionalmente.
mechanics.officialSummary: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Execução
mechanics.note: Wind Slash escala com vida perdida e é projétil em cone; shield/cura e dodge alteram limiar.
mechanics.officialSummary: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Heat fortalece habilidades, mas superaquecimento silencia e força autos; janela é poderosa e previsível.
mechanics.officialSummary: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Linha de dano/slow sem canal domina corredores e corta retirada; mobilidade perpendicular sai mais rápido.
mechanics.officialSummary: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Point-and-click só enraíza com Flux prévio; sem marca é slow, então a entrega exige dois passos.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.

mechanics.label: Portal de terreno
mechanics.note: Transporta aliados e minions após canal para engage, escape ou macro; CC em Ryze cancela e inimigo pode ler destino.
mechanics.officialSummary: Passively, Overload deals even more damage against targets with Flux.On cast, Ryze creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported to the target location.

mechanics.label: Negação de projéteis
mechanics.note: Destrói projéteis ao redor em dois pulsos; ameaça curta e móvel que pode apagar ultimates centrais.
mechanics.officialSummary: Samira slashes around her, damaging enemies and destroying enemy missiles.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Estende knockup após imobilização aliada e avança ao range; draft com setup muda completamente seu acesso.
mechanics.officialSummary: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up briefly.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Só lança em rank S e pode ser interrompida; precisa empilhar estilo e sobreviver no corpo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her.

mechanics.label: Imunidade a slows
mechanics.note: Fora de combate recebe Frost Armor com imunidade a slow e resistências; poke remove antes do engage.
mechanics.officialSummary: After being out of combat, Sejuani gains Frost Armor which grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows. Frost Armor persists for a short time after Sejuani takes damage. Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage.

mechanics.label: Habilidade vinculada a aliado
mechanics.note: Aliados melee aplicam stacks para stun; composição muda velocidade e quantidade de alvos controláveis.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Projétil atordoa primeiro campeão e cria tempestade; spell shield/frontline interceptam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sejuani throws her bola that freezes and stuns the first champion hit and creates an ice storm that slows other enemies.

mechanics.label: Escalonamento infinito
mechanics.note: Souls aumentam alcance, dano e crítico; pressão e duração mudam perfil.
mechanics.officialSummary: When units die near Senna, their souls are periodically trapped by the Black Mist. Senna can attack these souls to free them, absorbing the Mist that held them in death. Mist fuels her Relic Cannon's power with increased Attack Damage, Attack Range, and Critical Strike Chance. Attacks from Senna's Relic Cannon take longer to fire, deal bonus damage, and briefly grant her a portion of her target's Move Speed.

mechanics.label: Camuflagem
mechanics.note: Névoa oculta identidade e concede camouflage a aliados, mas proximidade e ataques revelam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Senna draws the Mist she has stored in her weapon into a storm around her, embracing darkness and becoming a wraith within. Allies who enter the area are camouflaged and also appear as wraiths as the Mist shrouds them. Wraiths gain increased Move Speed, are unselectable, and hide their identities.

mechanics.label: Proteção global
mechanics.note: Feixe global causa dano no centro e escuda aliados em largura enorme, influenciando luta remota.
mechanics.officialSummary: Senna calls upon the relic stones of fallen Sentinels, splitting her relic cannon into a holy array of shadow and light. She then fires a global beam that shields allies from harm, while damaging enemies caught in the center.

mechanics.label: Arsenal de habilidades selecionável
mechanics.note: A cada terceira habilidade ocorre double cast, alterando controle, cura e dano disponíveis naquele instante.
mechanics.officialSummary: Every third basic spell will cast twice from Seraphine. Additionally, casting spells near allies grants her bonus magic damage and range on her next basic attack.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Charm estende alcance ao tocar qualquer campeão, aliado ou inimigo; formação pode multiplicar ou bloquear rota.
mechanics.officialSummary: Seraphine deals damage and charms enemies hit, refreshing the range with every allied or enemy champion hit.

mechanics.label: Amplificação de cura e escudo
mechanics.note: Com escudo prévio, segundo cast cura por vida perdida em área; composição de shields habilita condição.
mechanics.officialSummary: Seraphine Shields and Hastes nearby allies. If she is already Shielded she will Heal nearby allies as well.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Centro causa dano verdadeiro baseado em Grit e concede shield; sair lateralmente ou deslocar Sett evita o núcleo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sett passively stores damage he takes as Grit. On cast, Sett expends all stored Grit to gain a shield and punch an area, dealing true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Ultimate point-and-click carrega alvo e causa dano por vida bônus em área; tanque inimigo pode virar projétil contra a própria backline.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sett carries an enemy champion through the air and slams them into the ground, dealing damage and slowing all enemies near where they land.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Só atordoa se puxar inimigos dos dois lados; formação e minions habilitam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sett pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him, dealing damage and stunning them. If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.

mechanics.label: Invisibilidade
mechanics.note: Blink com invisibilidade cria ângulos não vistos; control ward não revela invisibilidade, mas AoE/reveal verdadeiro sim.
mechanics.officialSummary: Shaco becomes Invisible and teleports to target location.His first attack while Invisible is empowered, dealing bonus damage and critically striking if he attacks from behind.

mechanics.label: Blink ou teleporte instantâneo
mechanics.note: O deslocamento instantâneo atravessa terreno e não é parado por anti-dash comum; grounding impede o cast.
mechanics.officialSummary: Shaco becomes Invisible and teleports to target location.His first attack while Invisible is empowered, dealing bonus damage and critically striking if he attacks from behind.

mechanics.label: Armadilhas e preparação de terreno
mechanics.note: Boxes invisíveis causam fear e zoneiam rotas, mas precisam armar e morrem para reveal/AoE.
mechanics.officialSummary: Shaco creates a hidden animated Jack-in-the-Box. When triggered, it will fear and attack nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Clone e engano
mechanics.note: Fica brevemente inalvejável e cria clone explosivo; disciplina, marca persistente e AoE identificam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies (Deals reduced damage to turrets). Upon death, it explodes, spawning three mini Jack in the Boxes and dealing damage to nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Evasão de ataques
mechanics.note: Zona ao redor da espada bloqueia ataques contra aliados dentro; spell damage e espera respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

mechanics.label: Proteção global
mechanics.note: Escudo global seguido de teleporte ao aliado; interromper Shen cancela chegada, burst pode atravessar escudo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Taunt em dash acerta linha e gera acesso; anti-dash/spacing punem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Forma dragão muda área/alcance das básicas e só existe com Fury; janela sem ultimate é explorável.
mechanics.officialSummary: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.

mechanics.label: Imparável durante ação
mechanics.note: Salto inicial é imparável e desloca, mas a forma posterior ainda sofre kite/CC.
mechanics.officialSummary: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.

mechanics.label: Grounding
mechanics.note: Adhesive impede dashes/blinks e desacelera; excelente para fixar móvel, limitado por alcance da zona.
mechanics.officialSummary: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Fling point-and-click joga alvo para trás e enraíza se cair no W; direção exige contato.
mechanics.officialSummary: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.

mechanics.label: Atuação após a morte
mechanics.note: Após morrer continua atacando com vida drenando; kite/CC e afastar-se depois do abate negam troca.
mechanics.officialSummary: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Knockup/dano crescem durante carga visível; interrupção ou sair da área evita pico.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.

mechanics.label: Imparável durante ação
mechanics.note: Carga longa fica imparável e causa knockup conforme distância, mas rota tem curva limitada e terreno bloqueia.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.

mechanics.label: Escudo de habilidade
mechanics.note: Nega uma habilidade e cura, premiando leitura; poke múltiplo/isca abre a janela.
mechanics.officialSummary: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.

mechanics.label: Mobilidade coletiva
mechanics.note: Velocidade coletiva inicia ou desfaz lutas e reduz cooldowns básicos com ataques.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.

mechanics.label: Travessia de terreno
mechanics.note: Carga atravessa terreno, agarra e atordoa ao colidir; visão lateral e anti-dash respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

mechanics.label: Supressão
mechanics.note: Suprime e arrasta até três campeões após preparação; spacing, spell shield e interrupção antes do cast reduzem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.

mechanics.label: Escalonamento infinito
mechanics.note: Stacks evoluem área, burn e execução do Q; tempo e acesso à wave são condições.
mechanics.officialSummary: Hitting champions with Abilities and killing enemies with Super Scorcher Breath grants a stack of Dragon Practice. Stacks increase the damage of Smolders basic Abilities.

mechanics.label: Travessia de terreno
mechanics.note: Voa sobre terreno por janela curta enquanto dispara; grounding e CC encerram segurança.
mechanics.officialSummary: Smolder takes flight ignoring terrain and bombarding the lowest health enemy.

mechanics.label: Execução
mechanics.note: Em stacks altos aplica burn e execução percentual, mudando frontline no late.
mechanics.officialSummary: Smolder breathes fire on an enemy. As he gains more stacks, this ability becomes more powerful.

mechanics.label: Arsenal de habilidades selecionável
mechanics.note: Power Chord pode reduzir dano, desacelerar ou ampliar burst conforme última aura; escolha é parte central do duelo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Stun em linha e redução passiva de cooldown; projétil e alcance médio permitem dodge/negação.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.

mechanics.label: Silêncio
mechanics.note: Zona instantânea silencia e depois enraíza quem permanece; destrói canais/combos, mas segunda parte é evitável.
mechanics.officialSummary: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.

mechanics.label: Proteção global
mechanics.note: Cura todos aliados vivos globalmente; anti-heal e burst acima da janela reduzem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.

mechanics.label: Escalonamento infinito
mechanics.note: Soul fragments concedem vida permanente e cura; hard CC e alvos pegos aceleram escala.
mechanics.officialSummary: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

mechanics.label: Vínculo que pune afastamento tardio
mechanics.note: Projétil retorna e enraíza na volta, depois permite pull; minions só importam na explosão e spacing lateral responde.
mechanics.officialSummary: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Ultimate continua enquanto drena campeões; disengage completo encerra, comp curta alimenta duração.
mechanics.officialSummary: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

mechanics.label: Roubo de ultimate
mechanics.note: Valor depende dos cinco ultimates inimigos, ratios e função; uma única ultimate excepcional pode mudar o pick.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.

mechanics.label: Redução extrema de dano
mechanics.note: Cura aumenta em vida baixa e dano é point-and-click; anti-heal, range e burst antes do limiar respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Splinters melhoram cada habilidade e dão pico final de AP; progressão é finita, mas altera regras do kit.
mechanics.officialSummary: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath from gaining levels and damaging enemies which upgrade her abilities.Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional chargeForce of Will: Bonus true damage.Scatter the Weak: Increased width and slows all targetsUnleashed Power: Executes low health targets

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Empurra inimigos/esferas; esfera alinhada vira stun de longo alcance, então objetos no chão definem ameaça.
mechanics.officialSummary: Syndra knocks enemies and Dark Spheres back dealing magic damage. Enemies hit by Dark Spheres become stunned.

mechanics.label: Execução
mechanics.note: Dano point-and-click escala com número de esferas e ganha execute após upgrade; stasis/range impedem cast ou impacto.
mechanics.officialSummary: Syndra bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres.

mechanics.label: Retirada ou proteção direta de aliado
mechanics.note: Engole aliado e o retira de alvo/dano antes de reposicionar; separação e cooldown limitam proteção.
mechanics.officialSummary: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally.

mechanics.label: Isolamento de alvo
mechanics.note: Após três stacks, engole inimigo e o remove temporariamente; exige contato acumulado.
mechanics.officialSummary: Tahm Kench devours a champion for a few seconds, dealing magic damage if they are an enemy, or shielding them if they are an ally.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Mergulho cria chegada larga após preparação visível; CC interrompe canal e reação lateral evita knockup.
mechanics.officialSummary: Dive down and then re-appear at target location, damaging and knocking up all enemies in an area.

mechanics.label: Interrupção de dash
mechanics.note: Dashes sobre o campo detonam pedras e atordoam; campeões dependentes de múltiplos dashes perdem entrada e saída.
mechanics.officialSummary: Taliyah creates a slowing minefield. If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Empurra na direção escolhida após atraso; combina com E, mas mobilidade e dodge reduzem confiabilidade.
mechanics.officialSummary: Taliyah causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing.

mechanics.label: Criação de terreno
mechanics.note: Parede semiglobal corta mapa e permite surfar; dano/CC derruba Taliyah e wall-cross atravessa.
mechanics.officialSummary: Taliyah creates a very long wall and then surfs it.

mechanics.label: Travessia de terreno
mechanics.note: Salta cada parede com cooldown próprio, criando rotas únicas; grounding e espaço aberto reduzem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

mechanics.label: Invisibilidade
mechanics.note: Lâminas e invisibilidade criam reposicionamento/burst; reveal e AoE preservam resposta.
mechanics.officialSummary: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

mechanics.label: Habilidade vinculada a aliado
mechanics.note: Habilidades também saem do aliado vinculado, duplicando geometria de stun/cura; separação quebra cobertura.
mechanics.officialSummary: Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.

mechanics.label: Invulnerabilidade
mechanics.note: Após atraso deixa aliados próximos invulneráveis; disengage durante preparação ou burst antes dela responde.
mechanics.officialSummary: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.

mechanics.label: Blind
mechanics.note: Blind point-and-click nega ataques e empowered autos; spell damage e cleanse aguardam janela.
mechanics.officialSummary: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

mechanics.label: Armadilhas e preparação de terreno
mechanics.note: Cogumelos invisíveis dão visão, slow e dano em área; sweeper, summons e alcance de limpeza respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.

mechanics.label: Camuflagem
mechanics.note: Fica invisível parado e pode mover em brush; AoE e reveal expõem.
mechanics.officialSummary: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

mechanics.label: Retirada ou proteção direta de aliado
mechanics.note: Lantern puxa aliado que clica e atravessa terreno; ward/campeões podem bloquear clique e CC impede interação.
mechanics.officialSummary: Thresh throws out a lantern that shields nearby allied Champions from damage. Allies can click the lantern to dash to Thresh.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Hook prende e oferece recast de entrada; minions, summons e projectile denial bloqueiam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Thresh binds an enemy in chains and pulls them toward him. Activating this ability a second time pulls Thresh to the enemy.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Flay instantâneo interrompe dash e reposiciona; alcance médio exige proximidade.
mechanics.officialSummary: Thresh's attacks wind up, dealing more damage the longer he waits between attacks. When activated, Thresh sweeps his chain, knocking all enemies hit in the direction of the blow.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Takedown e detonação máxima de E resetam salto; CC durante o voo interrompe.
mechanics.officialSummary: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Knockback point-and-click afasta diver ou explode bomb em área; também pode salvar o alvo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.

mechanics.label: Criação de terreno
mechanics.note: Pilar instantâneo cria terreno, interrompe canais/movimentos e desacelera; blink/dash pode atravessar.
mechanics.officialSummary: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

mechanics.label: Roubo de atributos
mechanics.note: Rouba vida e resistências, tornando tanque inimigo mais frágil enquanto fortalece Trundle.
mechanics.officialSummary: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.

mechanics.label: Impede morte
mechanics.note: Não cai abaixo da vida mínima e pode lançar sob a maioria dos CCs; kite/stasis vencem a janela.
mechanics.officialSummary: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

mechanics.label: Travessia de terreno
mechanics.note: Spin atravessa terreno e reduz cooldown com críticos; blind/evasão diminuem recasts.
mechanics.officialSummary: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Gold Card é stun por ataque selecionável e visível; alcance de auto e spell shield limitam entrega.
mechanics.officialSummary: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.

mechanics.label: Visão global
mechanics.note: Revela todos inimigos, reduzindo stealth/flanco e habilitando Destiny.
mechanics.officialSummary: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.

mechanics.label: Entrada global ou semiglobal
mechanics.note: Teleporte semiglobal cria números, mas canal e destino visível permitem resposta.
mechanics.officialSummary: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.

mechanics.label: Camuflagem
mechanics.note: Camuflagem longa prepara flanco; control ward/proximidade e reveal respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.

mechanics.label: Ataques com regra própria
mechanics.note: Autos ganham alcance e atravessam como projéteis que podem errar unidades em movimento; formação alinhada amplia dano.
mechanics.officialSummary: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.

mechanics.label: Arsenal de habilidades selecionável
mechanics.note: Awaken escolhe uma de quatro posturas ampliadas; usar uma bloqueia todas até novo cooldown.
mechanics.officialSummary: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances and can Recast an Ability to renew it with Ultimate benefits. Additionally, after using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks gain Attack Speed.

mechanics.label: Imunidade a controle
mechanics.note: Awakened Stampede concede imunidade a CC por janela curta e stun por contato.
mechanics.officialSummary: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them. Recast: Gain even more movement speed and immunity to immobilizing effects for a couple seconds.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Tempestade acompanha o último alvo atingido na versão Awakened, punindo alvos sem saída.
mechanics.officialSummary: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Recast: Empower and unleash the storm, causing it to track enemies and deal additional damage.

mechanics.label: Ataques com regra própria
mechanics.note: Dispara automaticamente no alvo próximo/priorizado e reduz velocidade; summons e posição desviam foco.
mechanics.officialSummary: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Dash com shield arremessa o primeiro campeão; windup pode bufferar CC, mas não é imparável.
mechanics.officialSummary: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.

mechanics.label: Execução
mechanics.note: Projétil marca e puxa abaixo do limiar para execução/fear; stasis, untargetable e cleanses específicos importam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.

mechanics.label: Dano percentual de vida
mechanics.note: Blight acumula por autos e habilidades detonam por vida máxima; negar autos reduz anti-tank.
mechanics.officialSummary: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Corrente enraíza primeiro campeão e espalha a próximos; spacing e negação de projétil impedem cadeia.
mechanics.officialSummary: Varus flings out a damaging tendril of corruption that immobilizes the first enemy champion hit and then spreads towards nearby uninfected champions, immobilizing them too on contact.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Carga aumenta alcance/dano, mas reduz mobilidade e pode ser interrompida.
mechanics.officialSummary: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

mechanics.label: Dano verdadeiro estrutural
mechanics.note: Terceiro hit causa dano verdadeiro percentual; blind, evasão e negar sequência respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Condemn só atordoa ao colidir com terreno, inclusive paredes criadas; campo aberto reduz ameaça.
mechanics.officialSummary: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.

mechanics.label: Invisibilidade
mechanics.note: Tumble concede invisibilidade durante ultimate, quebrando seleção repetidamente; reveal/AoE respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter

mechanics.label: Escalonamento infinito
mechanics.note: Acertos e abates acumulam AP sem limite; alcance à wave e duração importam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

mechanics.label: Criação de terreno
mechanics.note: Cage cria perímetro que atordoa quem cruza, isolando zona mesmo sem acerto direto; blink atravessa, dash toca borda.
mechanics.officialSummary: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

mechanics.label: Execução
mechanics.note: Dano point-and-click cresce com vida perdida; stasis, spell shield e cura antes do impacto respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.

mechanics.label: Dano verdadeiro estrutural
mechanics.note: Três stacks detonam dano verdadeiro; negar sequência reduz anti-resistência.
mechanics.officialSummary: Vel'Koz's abilities apply Organic Deconstruction to enemies on hit. If 3 stacks are accumulated, the enemy will take a burst of true damage.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Feixe longo desacelera e causa verdadeiro em alvos pesquisados; dive/interrupção corta canal.
mechanics.officialSummary: Vel'Koz unleashes a channelled beam that follows the cursor for 2.5 seconds that deals magic damage. Organic Deconstruction Researches enemy champions causing them to take true damage instead.

mechanics.label: Interrupção de dash
mechanics.note: Dashes/blinks inimigos ficam marcados e aceleram Gloom; fear preparado interrompe entrada.
mechanics.officialSummary: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Projétil marca e recast leva Vex ao alvo, resetando em takedown; spell shield/frontline e posição final punem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion. Recast to dash to them and deal damage.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Ultimate point-and-click persegue, fica imparável e knockupa; não é peelada na trajetória, mas o destino prepara resposta.
mechanics.officialSummary: Vi runs down an enemy, knocking aside anyone in the way. When she reaches her target she knocks it into the air, jumps after it, and slams it back into the ground.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Dash carregado é interrompível e telegráfico; acerto desloca e abre combo.
mechanics.officialSummary: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.

mechanics.label: Possessão e uso do kit inimigo
mechanics.note: Após takedown usa itens e básicas do inimigo, cura e fica inalvejável na transformação; valor depende dos kits disponíveis.
mechanics.officialSummary: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Heartbreaker fica disponível em cada possessão e executa vida perdida, saltando entre corpos.
mechanics.officialSummary: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Fragments melhoram básicas e depois ultimate; evolução muda alcance e controle, embora seja finita.
mechanics.officialSummary: Viktor gains Hex Fragments whenever he kills an enemy. With every 100 Hex Fragments he obtains, Viktor permanently augments an active ability. After upgrading all of his basic abilities, he can gather 100 Hex Fragments to augment his ultimate ability.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Campo desacelera e atordoa quem permanece, excelente contra curta distância, evitável por mobilidade/range.
mechanics.officialSummary: Viktor conjures a heavy gravitational field that slows enemies caught within its radius. Enemies who stay in the field for too long become stunned.Augment: Viktor's spells apply a slow to enemies.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Tempestade interrompe canais no impacto e persegue; sair do raio ou matar Viktor reduz controle.
mechanics.officialSummary: Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm on the field, dealing magic damage and interrupting enemy channels. The storm periodically does magic damage to all nearby enemies and can be redirected by Viktor.Augment: The Arcane Storm moves 25% faster, and whenever champions die after taking damage from it, the storm grows and increases in its duration.

mechanics.label: Intargetabilidade
mechanics.note: Pool fica inalvejável e atravessa unidades, mas custa vida; zona persistente e timing da saída punem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.

mechanics.label: Amplificação de dano recebido
mechanics.note: Marca área, amplifica dano recebido e cura Vladimir depois; disengage durante a janela reduz conversão.
mechanics.officialSummary: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.

mechanics.label: Desabilita torre
mechanics.note: Salto desabilita torres atingidas, criando dives que outros bruisers não executam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health. Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.

mechanics.label: Imparável durante ação
mechanics.note: Salto é imparável durante a ação, mas Volibear ainda sofre kite depois da chegada.
mechanics.officialSummary: Volibear leaps to a target location, Slowing and damaging enemies beneath him while gaining bonus Health. Enemy towers near his landing location become temporarily disabled.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Ataque stun point-and-click; se imobilizado antes de acertar, cooldown reseta, então uma única camada de CC pode ajudar.
mechanics.officialSummary: Volibear gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Ao segurar, acompanha dashes/blinks e fica imune a displacement durante a mordida; pode ser levado para posição ruim.
mechanics.officialSummary: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.

mechanics.label: Redução extrema de dano
mechanics.note: Reduz dano e depois causa fear em área; burst pode esperar recast, cleanse responde ao fear.
mechanics.officialSummary: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.

mechanics.label: Supressão
mechanics.note: Salto escala com velocidade e suprime primeiro campeão; pode errar e CC após chegada interrompe canal.
mechanics.officialSummary: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.

mechanics.label: Clone e engano
mechanics.note: Dash/invisibilidade deixa clone que ataca e replica ultimate; reveal/AoE identificam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Wukong becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Dois casts de knockup em área móvel, também replicados pelo clone; exige entrada, mas cobre formação ampla.
mechanics.officialSummary: Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed.Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Feathers no chão retornam e enraízam com três; posição acumulada define ameaça e pode ser evitada lateralmente.
mechanics.officialSummary: Xayah calls back all her dropped Feathers dealing damage and rooting enemies.

mechanics.label: Intargetabilidade
mechanics.note: Fica inalvejável durante salto e espalha penas, negando engage direcionado; zona na queda pune.
mechanics.officialSummary: Xayah leaps into the air becoming untargetable and throwing out a fan of daggers, dropping Feathers she can recall.

mechanics.label: Aumento excepcional de alcance
mechanics.note: Carga fornece poke extremo, mas reduz movimento e revela timing; flanco/engage durante carga pune.
mechanics.officialSummary: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Canal imóvel lança vários tiros de alcance enorme; dive, visão e mobilidade lateral reduzem acertos.
mechanics.officialSummary: Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages.

mechanics.label: Controle de longo alcance
mechanics.note: Stun cresce com distância, porém minions e projectile denial bloqueiam; no corpo dura pouco.
mechanics.officialSummary: Deals magic damage to an enemy and stuns them.

mechanics.label: Imunidade a ameaças externas
mechanics.note: Dano de campeões fora do círculo não o afeta; ranged precisam entrar ou esperar, salvo alvo desafiado.
mechanics.officialSummary: Xin Zhao passively challenges an enemy he damaged recently. When activated, Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back, becoming impervious to damage dealt by champions outside of the circle created.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Spear marca e aumenta alcance do E, transformando skillshot em acesso; dodge impede.
mechanics.officialSummary: Xin Zhao slashes in front of himself with his spear, then thrusts it forward, slowing affected enemies and marking them as Challenged.

mechanics.label: Negação de projéteis
mechanics.note: Parede destrói projéteis por vários segundos e pode invalidar carries/ultimates; não-projéteis e flanco contornam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Creates a moving wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Dash usa cada unidade uma vez por cooldown, fazendo wave/summons virarem rede de acesso e fuga.
mechanics.officialSummary: Dashes through target enemy, dealing magic damage. Each cast increases subsequent dash's damage, up to a max amount.Cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds.If Steel Tempest is cast while dashing, it will strike as a circle.

mechanics.label: Perseguição ou recast em alvo marcado
mechanics.note: Só ulta alvos airborne, inclusive por aliados; draft de knockup aumenta confiabilidade.
mechanics.officialSummary: Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing physical damage and holding all Airborne enemies in the area in the air. Grants maximum Flow but resets all stacks of Gathering Storm.For a moderate time afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes gain significant Bonus Armor Penetration.

mechanics.label: Retorno forçado a uma posição
mechanics.note: Deixa corpo-âncora e retorna obrigatoriamente; CC/zona atrasada na âncora ou afastar alvo nega saída segura.
mechanics.officialSummary: Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Dash em linha leva Yone atrás do último atingido e agrupa alvos; desvio lateral e posição final são cruciais.
mechanics.officialSummary: Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him.

mechanics.label: Criação de terreno
mechanics.note: Parede circular prende quem não cruza terreno; autos rápidos, dash e Flash removem/atravessam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: Ghouls e Maiden formam exército persistente; AoE, Smite e isolamento removem base de dano.
mechanics.officialSummary: The Cursed Horde: Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Maiden aplica marca percentual e pressão autônoma, mas não acompanha Realm do Mordekaiser.
mechanics.officialSummary: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.

mechanics.label: Mudança de forma ou arsenal
mechanics.note: Transcendência aprimora todas as básicas e muda W/E, criando janela de carry rastreável.
mechanics.officialSummary: Yunara enters a Transcendent State that upgrades her basic Abilities.

mechanics.label: Ataques com regra própria
mechanics.note: Críticos causam dano mágico adicional e Q transforma autos em splash/on-hit.
mechanics.officialSummary: Yunara's Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage.

mechanics.label: Anexação a aliado
mechanics.note: Fica inalvejável anexada e amplifica um aliado; separação depende da morte/posição do host.
mechanics.officialSummary: Yuumi dashes to a target ally, becoming untargetable from everything except turrets. While on her Best Friend, she gains Heal & Shield Power and grants her Ally On-Hit healing.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Anexada controla a trajetória inicial do projétil; bodyblock e distância do host limitam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Yuumi fires a missile, dealing damage and slowing first target hit. It deals bonus damage and an enchanced slow if it takes at least 1.35 seconds to get to its target. While on her Best Friend, the slow is always enhanced and grants bonus On-Hit damage to her ally.While Attached, the missile can be controlled with your cursor for a brief period.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Ondas canalizadas curam aliados e desaceleram inimigos enquanto Yuumi troca de host.
mechanics.officialSummary: Yuumi channels five waves that damage enemies and heal allies. Yuumi can move, attach, and cast Zoomies! while channeling. While on her Best Friend, this spell also follows her mouse.

mechanics.label: Revive próprio
mechanics.note: Ao encher determinação pode reviver em vida cheia; negar stacks e preparar segundo abate responde.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zaahen's attacks and abilities against enemy champions grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Segundo ataque fortalecido knockupa e ambos curam; blind/evasão e spacing quebram sequência.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zaahen slashes twice on his next attack, dealing bonus damage and healing himself. Zaahen can recast this ability to have his next attack deal bonus damage and knock up his target.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Linha puxa inimigos atingidos; dodge lateral e proteção de projétil respondem quando aplicável.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him.

mechanics.label: Revive próprio
mechanics.note: Divide-se em blobs que precisam ser destruídos; AoE, Smite e controle de área garantem segundo abate.
mechanics.officialSummary: Each time Zac hits an enemy with an ability, he sheds a chunk of himself that can be reabsorbed to restore Health. Upon taking fatal damage, Zac splits into 4 bloblets that attempt to recombine. If any bloblets remain, he will revive with an amount of Health depending on the Health of the surviving bloblets. Each bloblet has a percentage of Zac's maximum Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. This ability has a 5 minute cooldown.

mechanics.label: Canalização central
mechanics.note: Carga de enorme alcance pode vir de fog, mas é interrompível e o destino é telegráfico.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zac attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Liga duas unidades e as bate; minion, ward ou summon habilita segunda âncora.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zac stretches an arm, grabbing an enemy. Attacking a different enemy will cause him to throw both targets towards each other.

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Sombras duplicam Q/E e oferecem troca de posição; rastrear sombra/cooldown define alcance e fuga.
mechanics.officialSummary: Passive: Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability. Energy can only be gained once per cast ability.Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for a few seconds. Reactivating Living Shadow will cause Zed to switch positions with this shadow.

mechanics.label: Blink ou teleporte instantâneo
mechanics.note: Trocar com a sombra é blink, não dash: grounding impede o cast, mas Poppy W e efeitos que só param dash não interrompem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Passive: Zed gains energy whenever he and his shadows strike an enemy with the same ability. Energy can only be gained once per cast ability.Active: Zed's shadow dashes forward, remaining in place for a few seconds. Reactivating Living Shadow will cause Zed to switch positions with this shadow.

mechanics.label: Intargetabilidade
mechanics.note: Fica inalvejável no início e aparece atrás do alvo, deixando sombra de retorno; CC/zona na saída e stasis negam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked.

mechanics.label: Amplificação de dano recebido
mechanics.note: Marca repete parte do dano da janela; shield, cura, stasis e negar follow-up reduzem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion, marking them. After 3 seconds the mark triggers, repeating a portion of all the damage Zed dealt to the target while they were marked.

mechanics.label: Ataques com regra própria
mechanics.note: Ataque básico é skillshot e Q funciona como ataque; blind interage diferente, bodyblock e projectile denial importam.
mechanics.officialSummary: Burst Fire shoots a burst of 7 rounds that deal attack damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack.

mechanics.label: Travessia de terreno
