mechanics.note: Dash atravessa paredes inteiras conforme ângulo; grounding/anti-dash e luta longe de terreno reduzem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zeri dashes a short distance and energizes Burst Fire to pierce through enemies. She will vault and grind over any terrain she touches.

mechanics.label: Reset de abate
mechanics.note: Acertos mantêm e ampliam velocidade durante luta prolongada; disengage completo remove stacks.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity and overcharges herself, gaining increased damage and stacking Move Speed that refreshes and gets stronger every time she hits an enemy champion. While overcharged, Burst fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains lightning between enemies.

mechanics.label: Execução de estrutura
mechanics.note: Satchel executa torre abaixo do limiar e cria ameaça de siege única.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after a delay, or when this ability is activated again. The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage. Ziggs can use the Satchel to hexplode vulnerable enemy turrets.

mechanics.label: Deslocamento
mechanics.note: Explosão lança Ziggs e inimigos, servindo de escape/interrupt; grounding e antecipação punem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after a delay, or when this ability is activated again. The explosion deals magic damage to enemies, knocking them away. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage. Ziggs can use the Satchel to hexplode vulnerable enemy turrets.

mechanics.label: Dano global ou semiglobal
mechanics.note: Bomba semiglobal causa mais no centro; mobilidade e visão permitem sair do sweetspot.
mechanics.officialSummary: Ziggs deploys his ultimate creation, the Mega Inferno Bomb, hurling it an enormous distance. Enemies in the primary blast zone take more damage than those farther away.

mechanics.label: Revive de aliados
mechanics.note: Marca aliado e revive se morrer na janela; esperar, disengage ou matar outro alvo reduz valor.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.

mechanics.label: Zona de acerto ou posição específica
mechanics.note: Duas bombas no mesmo alvo causam stun; primeira pode ser carregada por aliado/minion.
mechanics.officialSummary: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies.

mechanics.label: Controle confiável
mechanics.note: Slow point-and-click extremo ou speed aliado; alcance médio e cleanse respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.

mechanics.label: Roubo de ultimate
mechanics.note: Coleta summoners/ativos caídos e reutiliza; valor depende dos feitiços disponíveis.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zoe can pick up the remnants of enemy summoner spell and active item casts and cast them once herself. Whenever she casts a summoner spell, she gains 3 missiles that fire at the nearest target.

mechanics.label: Sono e amplificação do próximo dano
mechanics.note: Projétil atravessa parede ampliando alcance e cria armadilha; bodyblock, cleanse e projectile denial respondem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Causes the target to become drowsy, then fall asleep. While asleep, the target's Magic Resist is reduced. The first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled, up to a cap.

mechanics.label: Retorno forçado a uma posição
mechanics.note: Portal sempre retorna Zoe ao ponto inicial; skillshots, CC e zona podem ser colocados na âncora.
mechanics.officialSummary: Blink to a nearby position for 1 second. Then blink back.

mechanics.label: Unidade invocada
mechanics.note: Sementes viram plantas e controlam zona; AoE/range clear e isolamento removem.
mechanics.officialSummary: Seeds spawn around Zyra periodically, becoming faster with level. Zyra can cast Deadly Spines or Grasping Roots near seeds to grow plants, who fight for Zyra.

mechanics.label: Dependência de objetos externos
mechanics.note: Posição das sementes define plantas, visão e DPS, tornando preparação central.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zyra plants a seed, lasting up to 60 seconds. Deadly Spines and Grasping Roots cast near seeds will turn them into plants who fight for Zyra. Zyra can store multiple seeds at once, and killing enemies reduces Rampant Growth's recharge time.

mechanics.label: Zona persistente
mechanics.note: Área causa knockup atrasado e fortalece plantas; sair antes da erupção ou interromper setup responde.
mechanics.officialSummary: Zyra summons a twisted thicket at her target location, dealing damage to enemies as it expands and knocking them airborne as it contracts. Plants within the thicket are enraged.
